rounds.company_description: Manufactures and operates orbital launch vehicles (Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Starship) and the Starlink low-earth-orbit broadband satellite constellation. Provides launch services to commercial, government, and NASA customers and direct-to-consumer satellite internet.

rounds.robotnik_take: Growth equity follow-on to $97M Series C from April 2022; brings total to ~$250M. SAR EO comp to ICEYE; strategic capital from Thomas Tull's USIT signals dual-use defense play.
rounds.company_description: Operates a constellation of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites delivering all-weather, day-and-night imagery. Sells to defense, intelligence, and commercial customers; competes with ICEYE in commercial SAR.

rounds.co_investors: Minyin International, miHoYo, Vision Plus Capital, Pagoda
rounds.robotnik_take: 400M RMB Series A funds Gravity-1 medium-lift launcher (6,500kg LEO) and Gravity-2 reusable engine R&D. China launch sector crowding; comp to LandSpace, iSpace.
rounds.company_description: Chinese commercial launch company developing the Gravity-1 medium-lift launcher (6,500 kg to LEO) and the Gravity-2 reusable methalox vehicle. Competes with LandSpace, iSpace, and Galactic Energy.

rounds.robotnik_take: ~400M yuan Series B/B+ for satellite manufacturing. Chinese satellite-maker peer to GalaxySpace; growing China commercial smallsat ecosystem.
rounds.company_description: Chinese small satellite manufacturer (also known as Beijing Weina Star Technology) supplying spacecraft for the country's LEO constellation buildout. Mass-manufactures buses and integrated satellites for state and commercial constellation customers.

rounds.co_investors: MetaVC Partners, Promus Ventures, Temasek, Scottish Enterprise, KTSat
rounds.robotnik_take: Note: SpaceNews dated Jan 11 2023 but BusinessWire/Crunchbase show Jan 11 2022. Confirmed via SpaceNews archive — funding announcement covered by SpaceNews in their Jan 2023 listing. MEO/HEO satcom + edge compute play; MNO partnership angle.
rounds.company_description: Builds a multi-orbit (MEO and HEO) satellite communications constellation paired with edge computing capabilities. Targets mobile network operators with backhaul and managed services.

rounds.robotnik_take: Co-led Series A funds OTV demo mission. Last-mile satellite logistics play; parallel theme to D-Orbit, Impulse Space, Launcher (acquired by Vast 2023). Atomos was acquired by Katalyst Space Technologies in April 2025.
rounds.company_description: Operated orbital transfer vehicles (OTVs) for last-mile satellite delivery. Acquired by Katalyst Space Technologies in April 2025; competed with D-Orbit and Impulse Space in the OTV segment.

rounds.co_investors: FCVC, Soma Capital, Liquid 2 Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Mission management SaaS for satellite operators founded by ex-OneWeb engineers. Below $3M threshold but flagship YC space deal in Q1; meaningful for ground systems/operations subsector tracking.
rounds.company_description: Builds mission management software-as-a-service for satellite operators. Y Combinator company founded by former OneWeb engineers.

rounds.co_investors: Anhui Sanzhongyichuang Industry Development Fund, Hefei Industry Investment, Sincere Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: Round size undisclosed; valuation now $1.58B. China's leading satcom challenger to Starlink; backed by state-aligned banks (CCB).
rounds.company_description: Chinese satellite communications company building China's leading commercial satcom challenger to Starlink. State-aligned bank backing including China Construction Bank.

rounds.co_investors: Mitsubishi Electric, Yusaku Maezawa ($23M), Mitsubishi UFJ Bank, Mitsubishi Corporation, Development Bank of Japan, FEL Corporation
rounds.robotnik_take: Leading on-orbit servicing/debris-removal pure play; total $376M raised since 2012. Pre-IPO; Astroscale later listed on TSE in 2024. Multiple strategic Japanese corporates.
rounds.company_description: Japanese in-orbit servicing and active debris removal company. Operates the ELSA series for end-of-life satellite removal and is developing JAXA-contracted active debris removal missions. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

rounds.co_investors: NewSpace Capital, Midway Venture Partners, Industrious Ventures, Seraphim Space
rounds.robotnik_take: Funding for Starlab commercial space station development. Later established Starlab JV with Airbus in July 2023; received $160M NASA CLD award. Voyager Technologies IPO'd in 2025.
rounds.company_description: Develops Starlab, a commercial space station planned as an ISS successor, in a joint venture with Airbus. Received a $160M NASA Commercial LEO Destinations award. Now Voyager Technologies, public on NYSE following a 2025 IPO.

rounds.co_investors: Countdown Capital, Boost VC, Also Capital, Side Door Ventures, Earthrise Ventures, Spacecadet VC, Pathbreaker Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Founded by ex-SpaceX engineers; 'Mega Class' high-power satellite buses leveraging Starship payload class. Bigger-is-better thesis vs. small-sat trend; comp to Apex Space.
rounds.company_description: Develops Mega-class high-power satellites — large, high-capability spacecraft designed for the heavy-lift launch era opened by Starship-class vehicles. Sells to constellation operators and government customers wanting more capability per spacecraft than current smallsat designs.

rounds.co_investors: Bayern Kapital, Earlybird Venture Capital, HV Capital, Lakestar, Lombard Odier Investment Managers, Porsche SE, UVC Partners, Vsquared Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Largest SpaceTech round of Q1 2023 globally; total raised >$330M. Funds Spectrum SLV development for sovereign EU launch. Comp to RFA, Latitude, Skyrora — leading European challenger to SpaceX.
rounds.company_description: Develops Spectrum, a small-to-medium-lift launch vehicle for European institutional and commercial payloads. Targets sovereign European launch capacity from Andoya Spaceport in Norway.

rounds.lead_investors: Cartesian Capital Group (via Pangaea Three Acquisition Holdings III)
rounds.co_investors: Telesystem Space, Luxembourg Future Fund, Investissement Quebec, Luxembourg Space Sector Development Fund (SES-backed)
rounds.robotnik_take: First commercial space-based SSA constellation (Skylark satellites). Comp to LeoLabs, Slingshot, Privateer. Strategic backers — Telesystem, SES — signal MEO/GEO operator demand for SSA. Later went public via SPAC in 2024.
rounds.company_description: Canadian operator of the Skylark space-based space situational awareness constellation. Sells SSA data to satellite operators and governments; went public via SPAC in 2024. Competes with LeoLabs and Slingshot Aerospace.

rounds.co_investors: Seldor Capital, 2 Future Holding, The Veteran Fund, Irongate Capital, Atypical Ventures, KittyHawk Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Lunar data center / disaster recovery storage thesis. Quintessential 'crazy space idea' that closed funding right after SVB shock. Niche but interesting — physical AI/data infrastructure tail risk play.
rounds.company_description: Builds lunar data centers for disaster recovery storage and edge computing. Speculative space-based data infrastructure play targeting commercial and government data sovereignty.

rounds.co_investors: Varda existing VC investors
rounds.robotnik_take: STRATFI deal: $30M government ($15M USAF + $15M NASA + $15M AFWERX) + $30M VC matching from existing investors. Hypersonic test bed using Varda reentry capsules. Dual-use defense play; pioneered govt+VC matched financing model for space hypersonic testing.
rounds.company_description: Operates in-space manufacturing satellites that produce pharmaceutical and materials products in microgravity and return them to Earth in reentry capsules. The same reentry capsules also serve as hypersonic test beds for the US Air Force and NASA.

rounds.co_investors: Siam Cement Group, The Engine, Energy Impact Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: MIT spinout (Yet-Ming Chiang/Leah Ellis) producing electrified cement at ambient temperature. Cement is ~8% of global CO2 — credible decarbonization play. Strategic from Siam Cement (SCG) signals offtake validation. Comparable thesis to Brimstone, but uses electrochemistry vs. calcium-silicate; both pre-revenue at this stage.
rounds.company_description: MIT spinout producing low-carbon cement using an electrochemical process at ambient temperature, bypassing the high-emissions calcination step of conventional Portland cement. Strategic partner Siam Cement provides industry validation.

rounds.co_investors: Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, SiteGround Capital, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BHP Ventures, Prelude Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: MIT spinout commercializing molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for green steel. Strategic from world's #2 steelmaker is structural validation. Series C first close; later expanded to $262M total in September 2023. Direct competitor to H2-DRI plays like H2 Green Steel/Stegra.
rounds.company_description: Commercializes molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for producing primary steel and high-value metals directly by electrochemistry, eliminating blast furnace coal consumption. MIT spinout; ships high-value metals as first revenue product, with full MOE green steel targeted for later commercialization.

rounds.co_investors: Emerald Technology Ventures, Material Impact, Arosa Capital, Nabtesco Technology Ventures, TechNexus, Hyde Park Angels, Evergreen Climate Innovations, Goose Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Silicon-anode developer with prior $10M DoD contract. Capital onshores domestic Si-anode production — directly relevant to Group14, Sila comp set. Smaller scale and earlier than Group14/Sila but DoD revenue is differentiated.
rounds.company_description: Develops silicon-based anode materials for high-energy-density lithium-ion cells. Holds a Department of Defense supply contract for military batteries; scaling North American silicon anode production.

rounds.co_investors: Temasek, Coatue, BMW i Ventures, Assembly Ventures, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Flex, Volta Energy Technologies
rounds.robotnik_take: LFP + dual-chemistry pack innovator (Aries/Gemini). $1.2B post crowned ONE a unicorn at the moment EV battery sentiment was peaking. Less of a pure-materials play vs. ONE's pack architecture, but vertically integrated cell/manufacturing thesis qualifies as battery materials infrastructure. Note: ONE later restructured in 2024.
rounds.company_description: Builds lithium-ion battery packs combining LFP cells (Aries) with dual-chemistry architectures (Gemini) for EV and stationary storage applications. Vertically integrated cell and pack manufacturer; restructured in 2024 after the EV-battery valuation correction.

rounds.lead_investors: Evok Innovations, BDC Capital Climate Tech Fund
rounds.co_investors: Volta Energy Technologies, NGP Capital, Helios Climate Ventures, The Grantham Foundation, Xora Innovation, Capricorn Investment Group
rounds.robotnik_take: Direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology focused on Latin American brines (Chile, Argentina). Series A2 at $50M brings total to $72M. DLE comp set with Lilac, EnergyX, Mangrove — Summit is differentiated by deployment focus on existing brine producers vs. greenfield projects. Rounds out the lithium upstream portfolio thesis.
rounds.company_description: Canadian direct lithium extraction (DLE) company focused on Latin American brines in Chile and Argentina. Deploys its denaLi technology at existing brine producers as an upgrade rather than building greenfield evaporation ponds.

rounds.co_investors: BP Ventures, Daimler, Samsung, EVE Energy, Roman Abramovich's Norma Investments
rounds.robotnik_take: Silicon-dominant XFC (Extreme Fast Charging) cell developer. Series D led by Vietnam EV maker VinFast as part of the VinES partnership for first-gen XFC cells in 2025 vehicles. Comp to Group14, NanoGraf, Sila — but StoreDot's go-to-market is cell-form-factor partnerships rather than anode-material licensing. Round size reported as $70M (closed) to $80M (target).
rounds.company_description: Israeli developer of silicon-dominant extreme-fast-charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells. Partnered with Vietnamese EV maker VinFast through the VinES partnership for XFC cells in production vehicles.

rounds.robotnik_take: Stellantis-Element 25 binding agreement: $30M strategic package — $15M equity at A$1/share + $15M offtake prepayment — to support Butcherbird (WA) manganese ore feedstock and a US HPMSM (high-purity manganese sulphate) processing facility (Louisiana). Q1 announcement; first $15M equity tranche closed July 2023. Combined with the GM $85M Element 25 facility (June 2023), positions E25 as the WA-to-US manganese cathode-precursor champion. Captures the OEM-funded onshoring playbook for unsexy but constraint-binding cathode minerals.
rounds.company_description: Australian-listed manganese miner developing the Butcherbird mine in Western Australia and a high-purity manganese sulphate (HPMSM) processing facility in Louisiana. Stellantis and GM are strategic offtake partners for EV battery cathode feedstock.

rounds.co_investors: Bullhound Capital, Daphni, Felix Capital, Air Street Capital, Creandum, Point Nine
rounds.robotnik_take: European VLA + world-model pure-play with US expansion via Boston — Sereact is positioning Cortex 2.0 as the warehouse-robotics middleware layer European 3PLs and grocers need but can't get from Symbotic (SYM) or AutoStore stack-vendors. Comp set: Covariant (Amazon-acquired), RightHand Robotics (Berkshire Grey-acquired), Dexterity AI on picking software; Symbotic and KION Group (KGX GR) as the public read on warehouse automation. European logistics-software sovereignty mirrors the cloud-sovereignty thesis.
rounds.company_description: German warehouse robotics software company building the Cortex 2.0 stack — a vision-language-action model combined with a world model for autonomous picking and manipulation. Expanding US operations from Boston.

rounds.robotnik_take: Pudu crossing $1.5B on an undisclosed-lead round signals Chinese service-robotics is consolidating around operator-OEMs with established global footprints — 60-country distribution is the actual moat, not the embodied-AI pivot narrative. Comp set: Bear Robotics (SoftBank-backed), Keenon on the Chinese side, Richtech Robotics (RR) on the US public side. Strategic frame is embodied-AI distribution leverage: OEMs shipping millions of service robots have the data-collection moat humanoid pure-plays are trying to build from scratch.
rounds.company_description: Chinese service robot manufacturer producing delivery, cleaning, and food-service robots, expanding into industrial delivery and embodied AI. Sells globally in over 60 countries.

rounds.robotnik_take: Largest Pre-A in China embodied-intelligence history — founder pedigree (Baidu Apollo + Huawei AD) is the actual basis for the round, not commercial traction. Comp set: Galaxea AI (2.9B), Spirit AI, PsiBot, X Square on the domestic side; Skild AI and Physical Intelligence on the Western side. Pre-A at this size only happens when Chinese state-aligned LPs are pre-positioning for the embodied-AI listings wave — Unitree's filing creates the precedent.
rounds.company_description: Chinese embodied-intelligence startup developing humanoid robot platforms, founded by veterans of Baidu Apollo and Huawei autonomous driving. Builds both the AI control stack and humanoid hardware.

rounds.co_investors: GL Ventures, 5Y Capital, Linear Venture, Hermitage Capital, Vertex Growth, Synstellation Capital, Prosperity7 Ventures, Xilian Capital, Joyoung Family Office, BAIC Capital, Didi, Meituan Longzhu
rounds.robotnik_take: Series B2 brings cumulative B-round to $270M and positions D-Robotics as the Chinese answer to NVIDIA (NVDA) Cosmos/Isaac — same picks-and-shovels embodied-AI compute thesis, different geography. Comp set on the Chinese side: Horizon Robotics (D-Robotics' parent), Black Sesame (2533 HK), plus in-house silicon at XPEV and BYD. Strategic frame is Chinese-market embodied-AI sovereignty: domestic robot OEMs need a non-NVDA reference platform under export-control overhang. Cap table reads as Tencent-orbit plus Temasek and BAIC/Didi/Meituan strategic.
rounds.company_description: Spinoff from Horizon Robotics building compute platforms and software stacks for embodied AI. Sells reference platforms positioned as a Chinese-market alternative to NVIDIA Cosmos and Isaac stacks for robotics developers.

rounds.robotnik_take: $110M is a deliberately small mark on top of the existing capital base — Skydio is signaling optionality rather than capital need, with the separate $3.5B US manufacturing pledge (Skyforge) as the load-bearing announcement. Comp set: AeroVironment (AVAV), Kratos (KTOS), Red Cat (RCAT) on the US-listed defense-drone side; Anduril and PDW as private peers; DJI as the China cost-anchor Skyforge is designed to displace. $4.4B post is a discount to Anduril-tier multiples. Reads as IPO conditioning more than financing.
rounds.company_description: Manufactures autonomous drones for public safety, defense, and industrial inspection, with onboard AI for obstacle avoidance and tracking. Sunset its consumer drone line in 2023 to focus on enterprise and government customers; more than half of its pipeline is defense-related.

rounds.co_investors: Ireland Strategic Investment Fund, Schooner Capital, Coca-Cola HBC, Molten Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: ARK Invest leading is the tell — a retail-investor-narrative vehicle anchoring a European drone-delivery operator means Manna is being positioned as the public-market proxy ahead of Zipline (private) and Wing (under GOOGL) on the listed side. Coca-Cola HBC strategic participation is the underrated piece, locking in consumer-brand distribution. Closest listed read-through is Joby and Archer on the eVTOL tape, though category mechanics differ. Reads as IPO-conditioning capital, not growth-mode burn financing.
rounds.company_description: Irish drone delivery operator running suburban food and retail delivery routes. Expanding into the US and broader European markets; competes with Zipline and Wing in last-mile drone delivery.

rounds.co_investors: Arm, Qualcomm Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: AMD leading with Arm and Qualcomm Ventures alongside is a pure chip-vendor strategic round on top of the $1.2B Series D — all three need a credible compute-agnostic AV stack to counter the Nvidia (NVDA)/Drive Thor lock-in and Tesla (TSLA) FSD-on-Dojo proprietary stack. Comp set: Mobileye (MBLY) on AV compute platforms, Horizon Robotics on the Chinese parallel; Waabi and Helm.ai on private end-to-end peers. The chip-vendor coalition is essentially financing Wayve as the anti-Nvidia option at zero dilution to mark.
rounds.company_description: Develops end-to-end embodied AI driving models that learn driving behavior from data rather than hand-coded rules. Licenses its self-driving stack to automakers and operates ride-hail pilots in the U.K., Germany, and the U.S.

rounds.co_investors: Innovation Industries, Ernij Next
rounds.robotnik_take: Rotterdam port-aligned LP plus Dutch national-fund participation pegs Smart Robotics as a Netherlands sovereign-industrial play — 1B successful picks across 120+ systems is real deployment scale that European intralogistics underwriters can credit. Comp set: Sereact and Covariant on AI-pick-and-place peers, Symbotic (SYM) on listed warehouse-automation, AutoStore (AUTO NO) on goods-to-person, Kardex (KARN SW) on industrial-automation. Series A at $10.8M is modest for the deployed base — round reads as European expansion capital.
rounds.company_description: Dutch developer of pick-and-place robotic cells for intralogistics, with more than 120 systems deployed and over 1 billion successful production picks. Targets European warehouse and distribution operators.

rounds.co_investors: DNX Ventures, Spacecadet Ventures, Position Ventures, Vivek Sodera
rounds.robotnik_take: Modular 'Legos for robots' development-kit positioning is the cleanest physical-AI-builder-platform play in this window — Matter Venture Partners plus Humba Ventures syndicate signals deep-tech conviction on the dev-platform layer rather than full-system integration. Comp set: Trossen Robotics on US dev-platform incumbent, Hello Robot on Stretch mobile manipulation, Unitree (private) on consumer-priced legged peers, Boston Dynamics (under Hyundai) on enterprise. Seed extension at $5.5M is modest — OpenARM and YAM platform adoption is the early-traction signal.
rounds.company_description: Builds a modular development-kit platform ('Legos for robots') for physical-AI builders, shipping the OpenARM and YAM platforms on launch. Targets the developer-platform layer alongside Trossen and Hello Robot.

rounds.lead_investors: Episode 1 Ventures, Asterion Ventures, Norrsken Evolve
rounds.robotnik_take: Offshore-wind subsea inspection is the European autonomy beachhead — $4M+ LOIs at pre-seed is the load-bearing signal, not the round size, because subsea AUV deployments are revenue-gated by certification not capital. Comp set: Saildrone on US surface-vessel autonomy, Ocean Infinity on hybrid manned-unmanned subsea, Kongsberg Maritime as the Norwegian incumbent counter, Anduril Dive-LD on defense-AUV; Oceaneering (OII) and TechnipFMC (FTI) as the listed subsea-services peers feeling the displacement.
rounds.company_description: French developer of persistent AI-driven autonomous underwater vehicles for offshore wind and subsea infrastructure operations. Competes with Saildrone and Ocean Infinity in maritime autonomy.

rounds.co_investors: Energy Impact Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: Eclipse leading a cabless AV-trucking seed is the late-cycle entry — AV-trucking has consolidated to Aurora (AUR), Kodiak, and Plus.ai, and Humble enters with a hardware-first cabless thesis when the surviving incumbents have all gone software-first. Comp set: Aurora on listed AV-trucking, Kodiak post-SPAC merger, Plus.ai on China-US dual-listed peer; TuSimple (delisted) as the cautionary precedent. Cabless Class 8 EV is the differentiator on paper; whether shippers underwrite the truck-only AV form factor is the real test.
rounds.company_description: Builds cabless autonomous Class 8 electric trucks for dock-to-dock freight. Targets the AV-trucking segment alongside Aurora, Kodiak, and Plus.ai.

rounds.co_investors: NGS Super, Xiamen Guosheng Fund, ABC Impact, Nanjing Ronghe Venture Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Largest China autonomous-trucking round in five years funds the Hong Kong listing prep; ~6,400 trucks delivered already gives DeepWay the most operational evidence of any AV-trucking name globally. Comp framing — TuSimple (delisted), Kodiak (private), Embark (defunct), Aurora (AUR) on the public side, Waabi and Plus on private — makes DeepWay the only name with serious commercial scale. Baidu's continued backing is structural; HKEX listing is the catalyst. Closest sector parallel is the path Pony.ai (PONY) took to public markets.
rounds.company_description: Chinese autonomous heavy-duty electric trucking company building both the trucks and the self-driving stack. Baidu-backed; approximately 6,400 trucks delivered to date as it pursues a Hong Kong listing.

rounds.co_investors: AI Fund, SaaS Ventures, Halogen Ventures, Harvard Business School Alumni Angels, New York Angels
rounds.robotnik_take: Multi-drone autonomy software-only positioning is the differentiator vs Skydio's vertically integrated hardware-plus-software approach — and Navy/IC/DARPA-founder pedigree is the underwrite for the DoD-channel thesis at seed stage. Comp set: Skydio on vertically integrated US drone, Shield AI on autonomy plus hardware, Brinc on public-safety drones, Anduril Ghost on defense autonomy. AI Fund participation is the underrated piece — Andrew Ng's vehicle taking a defense-drone software stake is the signal that LLM-stack veterans are pivoting into physical-AI.
rounds.company_description: Builds multi-drone autonomy software for first responders and the Department of Defense. Founded by US Navy, intelligence community, and DARPA veterans; competes with Skydio, Shield AI, and Brinc on a software-first approach.

rounds.lead_investors: Suzuki Motor, ACS Group, Khosla Ventures
rounds.co_investors: Mitsui Chemicals, Gates Frontier, Obayashi Corporation
rounds.robotnik_take: Suzuki and Mitsui Chemicals strategics alongside Khosla is the cleanest signal that micro-transit guideway-AV is being priced as a separate category from robotaxi — Glydways is closer to a Skytrain replacement than a Waymo competitor. Comp set: Zoox (Amazon-owned) on operator-owned pod fleets, Ultra Global PRT on legacy guideway; no direct public proxy. UAE, NYC, and Atlanta pilots in commercial operation give Glydways the most active deployment story in AV-transit. $700M is reasonable for the first round where revenue is no longer hypothetical.
rounds.company_description: Builds an autonomous personal-transit network — small electric pods running on dedicated guideway infrastructure. Operational pilots running in the UAE, New York City, and Atlanta.

rounds.co_investors: RiSC Capital, Grep VC, Nimbus Synergies, Dan Gelbart
rounds.robotnik_take: Cruz pods deployed at YVR and Madrid-Barajas is real operational footprint, but the airport-mobility category is structurally thin — accessibility TAM is constrained by airport-by-airport procurement cycles and unit economics scale poorly without network density. Comp set: Glydways on US guideway-AV with Khosla-backed scale, Whill (private) on personal mobility devices, Einride on adjacent autonomous transit. Series A at $5.7M is reasonable for the deployment base — round reads as airport-by-airport expansion capital, not category-redefining.
rounds.company_description: Canadian manufacturer of Cruz autonomous passenger pods deployed at YVR (Vancouver) and Madrid-Barajas airports. Targets airport mobility and accessibility applications.

rounds.co_investors: Eclipse Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Coatue, Pathbreaker Ventures, Island Green Capital, Socium Ventures, AE Ventures, RTX Ventures, Presidio Ventures (Sumitomo), UP.Partners, KAS Venture Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: Boeing AE Ventures + RTX Ventures + Sumitomo on the cap table is the load-bearing signal — autonomous cargo aviation is now being underwritten by the primes themselves, not just venture capital. Comp set: Joby (JOBY) and Archer (ACHR) on eVTOL, Xwing on autonomous cargo (acquired by Joby), Merlin Labs as private peer, AeroVironment (AVAV) as the public proxy on autonomous aviation broadly. DOT eIPP selection plus 200+ committed orders gives Reliable the regulatory moat. Cleanest pre-revenue cargo-AV bet.
rounds.company_description: Builds a fully automated, FAA-certifiable autonomy system for cargo aircraft, retrofitting existing fleets for pilotless operation. More than 200 committed orders; selected for the US Department of Transportation's eIPP program.

rounds.co_investors: Decisive Point, Booz Allen Ventures, BVVC, Neman Ventures, Evolution VC Partners, Heraclitus Capital Management, Sigmas Group, Disruptive Founders Fund, Vaughn Capital Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: Foundation model for unmanned warfare reasoning across all four domains is the most ambitious software-only defense-AI thesis in the dataset — Scout is competing with in-house autonomy stacks at the verticalized primes, not just other software vendors. Comp set: Anduril Lattice (cross-domain command), Shield AI Hivemind, Palantir (PLTR) Maven on targeting/intel; Booz Allen and Draper on the cap table provides integrator + IC pull. JADC2 stack is consolidating around 3-4 platform-autonomy vendors — Scout is positioning for the brain-layer.
rounds.company_description: Builds a foundation model for unmanned warfare reasoning across air, land, sea, and space domains. Holds approximately $11M in Department of War contracts in its first year; competes with Anduril Lattice and Shield AI Hivemind on multi-domain autonomy.

rounds.co_investors: Booz Allen Ventures, Lockheed Martin Ventures, In-Q-Tel, New Enterprise Associates, Ondas, Geodesic, Motley Fool Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Containerized in-theater 3D-printing of attritable drones is the cleanest Ukraine-war-lessons-learned bet that has translated into a US procurement-ready product. Comp set: Anduril Roadrunner on attritable autonomy, AeroVironment (AVAV) Switchblade on precedent product, Saab Carl-Gustaf on consumable-munitions doctrine. Lockheed Martin Ventures + In-Q-Tel + Booz Allen Ventures on the cap table is the strongest IC-and-prime validation in the window — one of the most strategically endorsed defense-tech rounds.
rounds.company_description: Builds expeditionary 3D-printed drones intended for in-theater manufacture by US and allied forces, targeting build cycles of under nine hours from spool to flight. Sells to DoD as part of the attritable-systems wave.

rounds.co_investors: AFL, Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, Pirelli, VC Partners SGR, MOST, ICO Falck Foundation
rounds.robotnik_take: Italy's largest AV round to date is more about industrial-policy positioning than competitive AV-stack capability — A2A, CDP, Pirelli, and Ferrovie dello Stato is a sovereign-industrial syndicate, not a tech-VC syndicate. Comp set: Wayve (UK) and Mobileye (MBLY) on the AV-software layer, Mercedes Drive Pilot on EU OEM-led autonomy. Niulinx is closer to a national-champion bet than a Wayve-tier AI-first stack; the test is whether Italian municipal robotaxi pilots materialize on the timeline implied by this cap table.
rounds.company_description: Italian autonomous vehicle stack developer spun out of Politecnico di Milano. Builds a full AV software stack targeted at European robotaxi deployments; comparable to Wayve and Mobileye Drive at the AV-software layer.

rounds.co_investors: Booz Allen Ventures, Harpoon Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Andreessen Horowitz leading an underwater-drone restoration play with Booz Allen Ventures alongside is the load-bearing combination — a16z brings consumer-AV brand, Booz Allen Ventures brings IC and DoD channel access. Comp set: Saildrone on US autonomous maritime, Bedrock on subsea autonomy, Anduril Dive-LD on UUV defense, Ocean Infinity on commercial subsea. Blue-carbon restoration is the entry wedge; the actual revenue thesis is offshore-energy and defense subsea work, where margins are real.
rounds.company_description: Builds autonomous underwater drones for marine ecosystem restoration — seagrass replanting — and offshore-energy and defense applications. Combines blue-carbon restoration with dual-use maritime autonomy.

rounds.co_investors: SuperSeed, Begin Capital, s16vc, VNV Global
rounds.robotnik_take: $25M seed for vertically integrated construction-robotics is the founder-pedigree trade — Samokat's $1.5B exit gives the cap table conviction, but the actual category (residential-construction automation) has a long graveyard. Comp set: Built Robotics on US construction autonomy, Dusty Robotics on layout, Saronic-adjacent Bedrock on equipment; Skanska and Vinci as the EU GC counters that would either partner or build in-house. Mantis legged-robot positioning is unproven; AI-architecture wedge is the realistic near-term revenue path.
rounds.company_description: Vertically integrated construction automation venture combining AI architecture software, robotic fabrication factories, and the Mantis legged robot for residential construction in Germany. Founded by the Samokat (Russian grocery delivery) founder.

rounds.robotnik_take: Lockheed Martin (LMT) leading as sole equity investor is the load-bearing fact — a prime taking the entire round signals Fortem is being absorbed into Lockheed's Sanctum counter-UAS ecosystem rather than scaled as an independent. Comp set: Anduril Roadrunner on attritable interceptors, Epirus on HPM counter-drone, Raytheon Coyote on incumbent prime systems, RTX (RTX) on adjacent C-UAS. Hanwha continuing as strategic gives Korean export channel access. Reads as quasi-acquisition financing, not growth-mode capital.
rounds.company_description: Builds the DroneHunter kinetic counter-drone interceptor and the SkyDome radar system. Strategic backers Lockheed Martin and Hanwha provide defense channel access; sells counter-UAS systems to militaries and critical infrastructure operators.

rounds.co_investors: Deeptech 2030 Fund (Bpifrance), Adamed Technology, Calm/Storm Ventures, Teampact Ventures

Comp set: Castle Biosciences (CSTL) on skin-cancer testing, DermTech (delisted) on the melanoma-diagnostics precedent, Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) on the broader surgical-robotics anchor. CE/FDA Class I-exempt fast-tracks 2026 US/EU launch — the regulatory path is the differentiator, not the imaging hardware.
rounds.company_description: Builds Swan, a robotic full-body dermoscopic imaging platform for skin examinations, CE-marked and FDA Class I exempt. Founded with backing from Intuitive Surgical co-founder Fred Moll's Sonder vehicle.

rounds.lead_investors: IRDI Capital Investissement, SWEN Capital Partners

Comp set: Mainblades on EU aircraft-inspection, Avitas Systems (under GE) on US inspection-drone, FLYABILITY on confined-space inspection; AAR Corp (AIR) on listed MRO. $11M Series B is modest for an EU defense-adjacent inspection player — round size suggests regional growth, not global expansion capital.
rounds.company_description: French manufacturer of automated aircraft-inspection drones with Airbus and Boeing certifications plus EASA and FAA approvals. The only operator with both Airbus and Boeing certifications for drone-based aircraft inspection.

rounds.co_investors: MaC Venture Capital, BoxGroup, Icehouse Ventures, Abstract

Comp set: Nvidia Isaac and Cosmos on the underlying stack, MuJoCo (DeepMind) on open simulation, Genesis (CMU/MIT) on open peer; Unity (U) and Roblox (RBLX) on adjacent listed-simulation IP. Transpose plus Meta Reality Labs plus DeepMind founder pedigree is the real underwrite at seed stage — execution risk on tooling stickiness.
rounds.company_description: Builds a simulation tooling layer for physical AI development, pitched as a 'Cursor for physical AI.' Founded by Transpose alumni and Meta Reality Labs/DeepMind hires; targets developer-first integration with NVIDIA Isaac and Cosmos.

rounds.co_investors: Ford Street Ventures, Cocoa, Begin, Entrepreneurs First, Transpose
rounds.robotnik_take: Initialized leading a construction-equipment retrofit-autonomy seed with $26M+ waitlisted contracts is the cleanest paying-customer signal — pre-commercial order book of 3.5x round size is unusual at seed stage and signals validated demand. Comp set: Built Robotics on US construction autonomy primes, Bedrock Robotics on equipment autonomy, SafeAI on retrofit peer; Caterpillar (CAT) and Komatsu (6301 JP) on listed OEM-adjacent counters. Vibratory-roller retrofit is a narrow wedge; whether scope extends to broader earthmoving determines the actual TAM.
rounds.company_description: Builds a retrofit-autonomy stack for vibratory rollers used in asphalt and soil compaction. Targets construction-equipment autonomy alongside Built Robotics and Bedrock Robotics.

rounds.co_investors: SWEN Capital Partners, GSO Innovation, Crédit Agricole, Spring Invest
rounds.robotnik_take: Tri-temperature autonomous click-and-collect grocery-dropper deployment with Leclerc and Intermarche is the under-appreciated French retail-automation signal — French hypermarket chains are the cleanest test market for last-mile grocery automation, with established click-and-collect adoption already at scale. Comp set: Ocado Smart Platform on UK incumbent automation, AutoStore (AUTO NO) on goods-to-person, Cleveron on parcel-locker robotics, Attabotics on US warehouse peer. 500-unit-by-2030 target is the binary scale-out gate.
rounds.company_description: French manufacturer of tri-temperature autonomous click-and-collect grocery drop boxes. Deployed with Leclerc and Intermarche; targets European grocery pick-up automation.

rounds.co_investors: Buckley Ventures, Topology Ventures, House Capital, Side Door Ventures, Also Capital, E14 Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: Founders Fund leading a $5.2M Boston industrial-robotics seed is the signal — FF rarely shows up at sub-$10M unless the founders are a known quantity, and this reads as a thesis-bet on the physical-AI builder-kit layer rather than a financial bet. Comp set: Anvil on adjacent industrial-automation tooling, Bright Machines on contract-manufacturing robotics, Path Robotics on metal-fab automation; Tesla Optimus and Figure as the humanoid-counter on the same factory floor. Single-source caveat applies on round mechanics.

rounds.co_investors: RunwayFBU, Lumaux, LUMO Labs

Comp set: Auterion on open-source drone OS, Skydio on US defense drone software stack, ResilienX on UAS traffic management; Kratos (KTOS) and AeroVironment (AVAV) as listed defense-drone counterparts. Dual-use European positioning is the strategic frame.
rounds.company_description: Dutch developer of drone-operations command-and-control software for security and defense customers. Customers include Dubai Police, Belgian Federal Police, and Shell.

rounds.co_investors: Eitzen, Barclay Holding
rounds.robotnik_take: Norwegian urban-ferry autonomy is a niche-specific maritime bet — Trondheim coastal-pilot lineage gives Zeabuz operational credibility commercial-scale peers lack, but $4M seed sizing implies city-by-city deployment rather than platform scale. Comp set: Sea Machines on US harbor autonomy, Avikus (HD Hyundai) on Korean OEM autonomy, Orca AI on vessel situational awareness, Buffalo Automation on US inland waterways; Kongsberg Maritime as the Norwegian large-vessel incumbent. Dual-use defense pipeline is the optionality.
rounds.company_description: Norwegian developer of autonomous urban-ferry and maritime navigation software with both civilian and dual-use defense applications.

rounds.co_investors: Financial Street Capital, CICC Capital, GL Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Series B extension at 2.9B — Galaxea is now the Chinese VLA-platform comp to Skild AI and Physical Intelligence. Two-month raise total exceeds 430M, putting Galaxea in line with Western brain-layer peers despite zero overseas commercial presence. Strategic frame: China-domestic embodied-AI brain layer, where domestic OEMs (Unitree, XPENG, Xiaomi) are being herded onto a domestic VLA stack by capital structure alone. Lens Technology lead is unusual — phone-glass supply chain capital entering robot software.
rounds.company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company developing general-purpose embodied AI platforms for industrial and commercial applications. Competes with Galbot, Unitree, and Agibot in the Chinese humanoid market.

rounds.co_investors: Meituan, Alibaba, ByteDance
rounds.robotnik_take: Xiaomi + HongShan-led with Meituan, Alibaba, ByteDance co-investing — the most strategically loaded mainland-China cap table in humanoid, period. Comp set: Unitree (profitable, IPO-filed), Galaxea (brain-layer), Spirit AI, TARS, PsiBot. The consumer-home rollout focus (WALL-B) is the differentiation; Unitree and Spirit are industrial-anchored. Read-through: Xiaomi anchoring suggests an eventual capture path back into Xiaomi's product line, narrowing the addressable market but increasing exit certainty.
rounds.company_description: Chinese embodied-intelligence startup developing household robots, including the WALL-A multimodal transformer for control and the WALL-B platform targeted at consumer home rollout. Strategic backing from Xiaomi.

rounds.co_investors: Bank of China Asset Management, Fosun Capital, Ant Group, HongShan
rounds.robotnik_take: Dexterous robotic hands at $3B with a $6B next-round target is the most aggressive humanoid-component valuation in the dataset — picks-and-shovels for the China humanoid wave with Zhongguancun + Ant Group + HongShan anchoring. Comp set: Sanctuary AI (Canada) on the hand-IP side, Shadow Robot Company (UK), plus in-house hand programs at Unitree, Figure, 1X, and Tesla (TSLA) Optimus. Chinese OEMs are bifurcating into in-house and outsourced — Unitree is in-house, Linkerbot is the merchant supplier for the rest.
rounds.company_description: Chinese designer of dexterous robotic hands for humanoid robot platforms. Sells hand subsystems to humanoid OEMs riding the Chinese embodied-AI wave; closest US comparison is Sanctuary AI's hand work.

rounds.co_investors: MITO Technology, LIFTT, SIMEST, RoboIT, Toscana Next
rounds.robotnik_take: Sant'Anna spinout with 50+ ALEX RS installations is real clinical footprint, but neuromotor-rehab exoskeletons remain a hospital-by-hospital sales cycle with stretched reimbursement — Ekso Bionics (EKSO) penny-stock status is the cautionary listed comp. Comp set: Ekso Bionics on listed US peer, Bionik Laboratories on micro-cap upper-limb rehab, Cyberdyne (7779 JP) on Japanese listed, ReWalk Robotics (now Lifeward, LFWD) on lower-limb. CDP Venture-led E5M Series A is sovereign-industrial Italian capital rather than scale-stage financing.
rounds.company_description: Italian Sant'Anna spinout building the ALEX RS upper-limb rehabilitation exoskeleton. More than 50 installations to date; competes with Bionic, Ekso, and Cyberdyne in neuromotor rehab.

rounds.co_investors: Catapult Ventures, Multicoin Capital, Finality Capital, Sky Dayton
rounds.robotnik_take: US-made drone SoC integrating flight-control, GPS, secure-comms, and onboard compute is the cleanest post-FCC-restriction supply-chain bet — HYFIX is positioned to replace DJI-supplied silicon as the China-decoupled drone-component default. Comp set: Ambarella (AMBA) on drone vision SoC, Innoviz (INVZ) and Aeva (AEVA) on adjacent sensor silicon, Skydio and Anduril as the prime drone customers. Craft Ventures lead plus Multicoin crossover is unusual — reads as DPA Title III-aligned positioning ahead of DoD procurement.
rounds.company_description: Builds a US-made system-on-chip for drones and robots that integrates flight control, GPS, secure communications, and onboard compute on one die. Positioned as an alternative to Chinese-supplied drone silicon after recent FCC restrictions.

rounds.robotnik_take: Schwarz Group absorbing its long-time picking/palletizing partner is European grocery vertical-integration — Lidl/Kaufland scale lets Schwarz capture intralogistics margin rather than rent it. Comp set: Symbotic (SYM) under Walmart as the US analog vertical integration, AutoStore (AUTO NO) on listed grid-AS/RS, Ocado (OCDO LN) on UK grocery automation IP, Knapp on Austrian intralogistics; Berkshire Grey (delisted, SoftBank-owned) on US warehouse picking. EU food-retail automation thesis tightens.
rounds.company_description: German developer of picking and palletizing robots for food retail intralogistics. Acquired by Schwarz Group (parent of Lidl and Kaufland) for in-house deployment.

rounds.robotnik_take: Accenture Ventures backing GRID is the channel-not-capital play — fleet-orchestration software with Isaac Sim integration only matters if the SI partner with enterprise rolodex drives deployments, and Accenture's manufacturing consulting practice is the load-bearing piece. Comp set: Formant on US robot-fleet ops, Freedom Robotics on dev-tooling for fleets, InOrbit on cloud robotics orchestration, Cogniteam on fleet management; NVIDIA (NVDA) as the Isaac Sim platform partner. Terms undisclosed; strategic, not financial.
rounds.company_description: Develops GRID, an intelligence layer that orchestrates heterogeneous robot fleets and integrates with NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Accenture is a strategic investor and commercial channel partner.

rounds.co_investors: CapitalG, M12 (Microsoft), Socratic Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: Sutter Hill + CapitalG + M12 on optical circuit switching is the cleanest hyperscaler-aligned bet on the AI-cluster interconnect bottleneck — Google and Microsoft both signaling they need an OCS alternative to the proprietary stacks behind Broadcom (AVGO) and Marvell (MRVL) optics. Comp set: Lightmatter Passage, Celestial AI, Ayar Labs on co-packaged optics; Coherent (COHR) and Lumentum (LITE) as the public read on legacy pluggable economics. Optical interconnect is the binding constraint for next-gen AI clusters.
rounds.company_description: Develops optical circuit switching for AI data centers, combining silicon photonics with MEMS optical switching. Targets the optical interconnect bottleneck in hyperscale AI clusters, competing with the TIA and laser stacks behind Broadcom and Marvell optics.

rounds.co_investors: Y Combinator, Rock Yard Ventures, IQT, University of Michigan, QDNL Participations, Expeditions Fund, 468 Capital, Morpheus Ventures, WTI, Overmatch Ventures, RRE Ventures, Switch Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Chad Rigetti's second act at quantum-accelerated AI servers funded by Breakthrough Energy, IQT, Y Combinator, and Michigan's endowment — the cap table reads as a long-duration deep-tech bet, not near-term commercial play. Comp set on heterogeneous-quantum: PsiQuantum (photonic), QuEra (neutral atoms), IBM (IBM), IonQ (IONQ); on the AI-accelerator counter, NVIDIA (NVDA). If quantum acceleration delivers usable speedup on any sub-domain, Sygaldry has the founder credibility to be first; if not, this is Rigetti 2.0.
rounds.company_description: Builds quantum-accelerated AI servers combining multiple qubit types in a fault-tolerant architecture. Founded by Chad Rigetti (founder of Rigetti Computing); pitches quantum acceleration as a path to lower training and inference cost than monolithic GPU stacks.

rounds.co_investors: Acclimate Ventures, Catapult Ventures, Xora Innovation, Capricorn Investment Group, Mayfield Fund, New Legacy
rounds.robotnik_take: Series A extension to $84M total positions OpenLight as the PDK-licensing alternative to in-house photonics — competing on IP openness rather than vertical integration. Comp set: Ayar Labs on optical I/O, Lightmatter on photonic compute, Marvell (MRVL) and Broadcom (AVGO) on co-packaged optics; Coherent (COHR) and Lumentum (LITE) as the merchant laser supply. Strategic frame is whether hyperscaler ASIC programs license PDKs or build proprietary photonic IP — outcome determines TAM.
rounds.company_description: Designs custom photonic chips with a process design kit (PDK) library including a 400G modulator and indium phosphide heterogeneously integrated lasers. Targets the AI optical interconnect layer alongside Ayar Labs and Marvell/Broadcom photonics.

rounds.lead_investors: Playground Global, Australia's National Reconstruction Fund
rounds.fx_source: Approximate AUD 37M reported in Australian press; USD ~26M
rounds.co_investors: Investible, Salus Ventures, Jelix Ventures, Wollemi Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Pat Gelsinger joining the board via Playground Global is the heaviest individual signal — the former Intel (INTC) CEO endorsing electrochemical advanced-packaging as a Series A bet means Syenta is being positioned as the picks-and-shovels alternative to TSMC (TSM) CoWoS monopoly. Comp set: Applied Materials (AMAT) and Lam Research (LRCX) on adjacent packaging equipment, ASE (ASX) and Amkor (AMKR) on OSAT incumbency; Tokyo Electron (8035 JP) on lithography-adjacent tools. Chip-to-chip copper interconnect is the AI-scaling bottleneck — clears if foundry validation lands.
rounds.company_description: Australian National University spinout developing electrochemical advanced packaging — a process for chip-to-chip copper interconnects targeting AI compute scaling. Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger joined the board.

rounds.robotnik_take: METI's second tranche brings cumulative Rapidus support to ~16B and crosses the threshold where the Japanese state is effectively underwriting a 2nm foundry against TSM. The strategic frame is sovereignty, not economics: the unit-cost math vs TSM N2 doesn't close, but a captive 2nm option for Fujitsu, NTT, and SoftBank is worth the subsidy alone. Closest analog is Intel Foundry's CHIPS Act funding, only more concentrated in one customer base.
rounds.company_description: Japan's flagship advanced semiconductor foundry, building a fab in Chitose, Hokkaido aiming for 2nm production by 2027. Technology transfer agreement with IBM; backed by Japanese government investment.

rounds.robotnik_take: Largest A-share IPO of 2026 YTD funds a domestic answer to TSM CoWoS supply constraints — SJSemi holds ~85% of China's 2.5D advanced-packaging share. The structural read is that Beijing has now backstopped both leading-edge wafer (SMIC) and advanced packaging (SJSemi/JCET) as separate state priorities. Closest comps: ASE Technology (ASX) and Amkor (AMKR) on the public side; differential is China-domestic customer pull driven by export-control overhang.
rounds.company_description: 12-inch middle-end-of-line foundry in Jiangyin, China specializing in advanced packaging — bumping, redistribution layer (RDL), and interposer services for chiplet integration. Positioned as a domestic alternative to TSMC CoWoS capacity for Chinese fabless customers.

rounds.robotnik_take: Marvell buying an ETH Zurich plasmonics-modulator spinout to scale 3.2T optical interconnects is the cleanest signal yet that co-packaged optics is moving in-house at the merchant silicon level — MRVL is tightening photonics IP ownership vs. Broadcom (AVGO) ahead of the 1.6T/3.2T transition. Comp set: Lightmatter and Ayar Labs on optical I/O, Coherent (COHR) and Lumentum (LITE) on merchant laser supply, Macom (MTSI) on photonic components. Terms undisclosed; strategic IP tuck-in.
rounds.company_description: Swiss ETH Zurich spinout developing plasmonics-based silicon photonic modulators for high-speed optical interconnects. Acquired by Marvell to scale 3.2T+ optical interconnect products.

rounds.robotnik_take: Second crack at a public listing after the 2024 attempt stalled on CFIUS review of G42 exposure. The 10B OpenAI inference contract and 510M FY25 revenue give this S-1 actual numbers behind it; comp framing is Groq (still private) on the inference side and NVIDIA (NVDA) as the architectural counter-bet. Cerebras IPO is the cleanest public-market read on whether non-GPU AI silicon clears at scale.
rounds.company_description: Designs wafer-scale AI processors and the systems that ship around them, including the CS-3 supercomputer and on-premises and cloud inference offerings. The wafer-scale approach packages an entire silicon wafer into a single chip with 900,000+ cores, targeting large-model training and inference workloads.

rounds.robotnik_take: Tuck-in that lets Credo (CRDO) finally span SerDes + DSP + silicon photonics in one stack — the same vertical integration play Marvell (MRVL) and Broadcom (AVGO) have been building. At 1.3B with meaningful earn-out, Credo is paying full price for the optics piece because the alternative is watching AVGO/MRVL pull away in 1.6T optical interconnect. Reads as defensive-offensive: small-cap pure-play forced to consolidate or be consolidated.
rounds.company_description: Israeli silicon photonic integrated circuit (PIC) startup spanning 400G to 3.2T optical interconnects. Acquired by Credo in a deal worth up to $1.3B; integrates SerDes, DSP, and silicon photonics.

rounds.co_investors: Hudson Bay Capital, Poalim Equity, LIP Ventures, Wolverine Global Ventures, IDA Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Series A extension from $100M (Dec 2025) to $140M total marks Quantum Art as the best-capitalized trapped-ion player outside IonQ (IONQ) and Quantinuum. Comp set: IonQ on listed trapped-ion, Quantinuum as the Honeywell-spun private peer, Atom Computing and QuEra on neutral-atom; Rigetti (RGTI) and IBM (IBM) as the superconducting-counter. 1,000-qubit Perspective system is the binary engineering milestone — clears if multi-core ion-trap scaling works, falls flat if coherence times degrade with qubit count.
rounds.company_description: Israeli trapped-ion quantum computer maker building the Perspective 1,000-qubit multi-core quantum system. Targets enterprise and government customers needing scaled quantum compute.

rounds.lead_investors: Cornerstone Capital, Guotai Junan Innovation Investment
rounds.co_investors: Zhejiang Caitong Capital, Sichuan Zhenxing Group, Chengdu Tianchuang Investment, Yida Capital, Huaqiang Capital

Comp set: QuantumCTek (688027), Origin Quantum, QBoson on the domestic side; IBM (IBM), IonQ (IONQ), Rigetti (RGTI) as the US public benchmark. The 15th Five-Year Plan is mobilizing state capital into quantum the way the Big Fund did for semis. SpinQ is the best-capitalized Chinese superconducting pure-play.
rounds.company_description: Chinese quantum computing company developing superconducting and NMR-based quantum systems for industrial and educational customers. Targets the domestic Chinese quantum hardware market under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

rounds.co_investors: M12 (Microsoft), Linse Capital, Vsquared Ventures, Future Ventures, Runa Capital, Deep Future, SETT Spain, Nysno Climate Investments
rounds.robotnik_take: Atomico leading with M12 (Microsoft) participating is the Norwegian-sovereign hedge against ASML (ASML) monopoly economics — the second major hyperscaler-backed alt-lithography round in this window after the Microsoft-led parallel raise. Comp set: ASML on EUV incumbency, Canon (7751 JP) on nanoimprint as the established alternate, Applied Materials (AMAT) and KLA (KLAC) on adjacent equipment. 0.1nm helium-atom beam vs 13.5nm EUV is the radical-physics bet; 2029 pilot fab pushes commercial validation deep into next CAPEX cycle.
rounds.company_description: Norwegian helium atom-beam lithography startup. Targets a beam wavelength much shorter than ASML's 13.5nm EUV for next-generation chip patterning, with a pilot fab system targeted for 2029.

rounds.co_investors: Sony Semiconductor Solutions (continuing as one of largest shareholders)
rounds.robotnik_take: Sony spinning Altair back out 10 years post-acquisition is the cleanest case study of cellular IoT failing to materialize inside an imaging-sensor conglomerate — the spinoff signals Sony is unwilling to underwrite eRedCap and 5G IoT through corporate balance sheet. Comp set: Sequans (SQNS) on cellular IoT, Qualcomm (QCOM) and MediaTek (2454 TT) on the modem incumbents, Sony (6758 JP) retaining stake as the strategic anchor. Connectivity-layer thesis hinges on physical-AI edge volume materializing.
rounds.company_description: Israeli fabless designer of cellular IoT chips. Spun back out of Sony 10 years after a $212M acquisition; focused on 5G IoT and eRedCap modems for physical AI and edge devices.

rounds.co_investors: (Existing investors), partnership program with Rigetti, QuantWare, Peak Quantum
rounds.robotnik_take: Quantum-test-and-measurement is the cleanest picks-and-shovels play in the quantum stack — OrangeQS sells qualification equipment to Rigetti (RGTI), QuantWare, and Peak Quantum regardless of which qubit modality wins. Comp set: Bluefors on cryogenic systems, Zurich Instruments and Quantum Machines on control electronics, Keysight (KEYS) on adjacent broader T&M. Role analog is KLA (KLAC) for advanced semiconductor packaging — supplier-side leverage as the industry scales, sector-agnostic on architecture.
rounds.company_description: Dutch quantum chip testing equipment startup providing test-and-measurement systems for quantum processors. Partnered with Rigetti, QuantWare, and Peak Quantum on quantum hardware qualification.

rounds.lead_investors: Stan Shih (Founder of Acer, former TSMC board)
rounds.robotnik_take: Stan Shih's strategic check into a 3D X-DRAM startup is a Taiwan-sovereign hedge against the SK hynix-Samsung-Micron HBM oligopoly — 8x density on existing 3D NAND tooling is the credible-if-true thesis, since reusing NAND CAPEX dodges the HBM TSV bottleneck. Comp set: SK hynix (000660 KS), Samsung (005930 KS), Micron (MU) as HBM incumbents; YMTC on Chinese 3D NAND, Kioxia (285A JP) on NAND tooling reuse; Marvell (MRVL) on custom HBM controllers. Memory-density binary on tape-out.
rounds.company_description: Develops 3D X-DRAM memory IP — a high-bandwidth memory alternative claiming 8x density on existing 3D NAND tooling. Targets the HBM bottleneck currently held by SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron.

rounds.co_investors: Verve Ventures, European Innovation Council Fund, EIC Accelerator + EU Chips Act grants
rounds.robotnik_take: QuTech spinout building CMOS-compatible germanium spin-qubits is Europe's most industrially fabricable quantum bet — the differentiator is leveraging existing semiconductor process equipment rather than building bespoke fabs. Comp set: Quantum Motion (UK) and Diraq (AU) on silicon spin-qubit peers, Intel (INTC) on the listed silicon-spin counter, Rigetti (RGTI) and IBM (IBM) on superconducting. EU Chips Act grant participation is the structural backing; integration-with-CMOS thesis is what gives this round its real optionality.
rounds.company_description: QuTech spinout building CMOS-compatible germanium spin-qubit quantum processors. Claims the largest semiconductor spin-qubit processor at 18 qubits; targets an industrially fabricable path to scaled quantum logic.

rounds.co_investors: European Innovation Council Accelerator, Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation (SPRIND), Kensho Ventures, High-Tech Grunderfonds (HTGF)
rounds.robotnik_take: Waveguide-integrated SNSPDs are the cleanest picks-and-shovels play in quantum-photonics — Pixel sells single-photon detectors to whatever qubit modality wins, identical leverage to the KLA (KLAC) role in advanced packaging. Comp set: Single Quantum (NL) and ID Quantique on competing SNSPD vendors, Quantum Opus on adjacent US peer; Keysight (KEYS) on broader T&M. E5M equity plus E8.5M EIC reflects the EU Chips Act's structural support — non-dilutive grant component is the unusual feature, lowering the equity cost-of-capital materially.
rounds.company_description: University of Munster spinout developing waveguide-integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) for quantum computing and photonic test and measurement. Picks-and-shovels enabler for quantum hardware customers.

rounds.robotnik_take: Largest front-end-semi IPO in ASEAN and the cleanest expression of the Malaysia/Penang-as-geopolitically-neutral-IP-hub thesis — SkyeChip is positioned to serve customers who can't or won't use US-listed silicon-IP vendors due to export-control overhang. Comp set: Silicon Labs (SLAB), CEVA (CEVA), Synopsys (SNPS) IP division on the public-IP side; ARM (ARM) as the dominant licensor everyone is trying to diversify away from. ASEAN sovereignty in semis is being built around Penang's existing OSAT base and now front-end IP.
rounds.company_description: Malaysian fabless integrated circuit design and silicon IP house based in Penang. Public on the Bursa Malaysia Main Market; targets AI silicon R&D and next-generation IP licensing.

rounds.robotnik_take: Sequoia-led stealth seed for Apple/Qualcomm/Nuvia alumni building AI-era datacenter CPUs is pedigree-trade pricing — the Nuvia-to-Qualcomm $1.4B precedent gives this team an implied valuation floor regardless of seed sizing. Comp set: Tenstorrent on RISC-V datacenter, Rivos and Ampere on ARM-server CPUs, Cerebras (IPO filed) on AI-native compute, SiPearl on European sovereign HPC; NVIDIA (NVDA) Grace and AMD (AMD) as the incumbent x86/ARM counters. Architecture choice undisclosed; speculative.
rounds.company_description: Stealth fabless CPU startup founded by Apple, Qualcomm, and Nuvia alumni. Targets AI-era data center CPUs as an alternative to x86 and ARM as agent workloads drive demand for new compute architectures.

rounds.co_investors: Paradigm, Atreides Management, G Squared, The Private Shares Fund, VanEck, Accel, Menlo Ventures, ACME Capital, Space VC, Meritech Capital, Narya, 645 Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Pure-play orbital defense round at 3x valuation step-up — Golden Dome contractor selection is the catalyst. Comp set is narrow: Anduril (private) on the broader defense-AI side, Rocket Lab (RKLB) Space Systems segment on the on-orbit hardware side, no real public-market pure-play. The 1B total raised and 500-headcount target by year-end signal the company is staffing for prime-contractor scale, not subcontractor. SDA architecture pivot from passive sensing to active proximity-operations is the underlying thesis.
rounds.company_description: Builds autonomous orbital vehicles (the Jackal AOV) and ground software for space domain awareness and rendezvous-proximity operations. Sells primarily to the US Space Force and Department of Defense for orbital security missions.

rounds.co_investors: Aurelia Foundry, Forward Deployed VC, FoundersX, Center15 Capital, Magnetar Capital, HOF Capital, Industrious Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: First NOAA-licensed commercial non-Earth-imaging provider with 28 USG contracts across Space Force, NASA, and NRO — Turion is being underwritten on a regulated-monopoly thesis as much as on technology. Comp set: LeoLabs and Slingshot on space-domain-awareness analytics, ExoAnalytic on ground-based optical SDA, True Anomaly on active proximity ops; no public pure-play. SDA is consolidating into 4-5 vendors, and Turion's maneuverable-satellite differentiation gives it the operational moat analytics-only peers lack.
rounds.company_description: Operates a constellation of maneuverable satellites for space domain awareness and non-Earth imaging. Holds 28 US government contracts across the Space Force, NASA, and NRO; first NOAA-licensed commercial NEI provider.

rounds.co_investors: Bpifrance Deeptech 2030, two family offices
rounds.robotnik_take: VLEO 5G constellation at 375km — well below Starlink's 550km altitude band — is the European sovereignty pitch dressed as a physics differentiator. Comp set: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) on direct-to-cell incumbency, SpaceX Starlink as the dominant LEO peer, Lynk Global on private D2C, Globalstar (delisting in progress, Amazon acquisition) on partnered satellite-cellular. 1,600-sat constellation at $32M Series A is laughably underfunded vs ASTS scale economics; round reads as European sovereign-capital seed before larger institutional rounds.
rounds.company_description: French operator of a planned 1,600-satellite very-low-earth-orbit (VLEO) 5G constellation at around 375 km. Formerly Constellation Technologies & Operations; targets a European sovereign direct-to-cell alternative to Starlink and AST SpaceMobile.

rounds.co_investors: MCH Private Equity, CDTI, Buenavista Equity Partners, Endeavor Catalyst
rounds.robotnik_take: Largest Spanish space round on record and the cleanest signal that the EU is funding sovereign Earth-observation capacity alongside launch and PNT investments. Comp set: Planet Labs (PL) and Maxar (private) on the public/global EO side, ICEYE on SAR-specific, Satellogic (SATL) as the small-cap public proxy. L3Harris sensor partnership is the load-bearing strategic — Xoople gets US sensor IP without US listing, L3Harris gets European distribution. EU EO arms race is real, with ICEYE and Constellr scaling capital in parallel.
rounds.company_description: Spanish earth observation company building an AI-optimized imagery constellation for government tracking, agribusiness, infrastructure, and supply-chain monitoring. Partnered with L3Harris on next-generation sensors.

rounds.co_investors: Booz Allen Ventures, ARK Invest, AlleyCorp, FUSE
rounds.robotnik_take: $45M SpaceWERX contract plus $50M Series A at $250M post is the textbook DoD-pull Series A — government anchor de-risks technology, private capital underwrites scale. Solar-thermal propulsion is the differentiator; closest comps are Impulse Space and Atomos on OTV, Phase Four on small-sat propulsion. Booz Allen Ventures + ARK + Geodesic is an unusually loaded syndicate for a $50M round, reading as Golden Dome-adjacent positioning. Starburst-1 flight execution in late 2026 is the binary milestone.
rounds.company_description: Builds the Supernova satellite bus equipped with solar-thermal propulsion for rapid orbital maneuvering. Holds a $45M SpaceWERX contract; first Starburst-1 mission scheduled on SpaceX Transporter-18 in late 2026. Founded by a former SpaceX Raptor engineer.

rounds.robotnik_take: Smallsat M&A consolidation moving into terminals — York vertically integrating bus + payload + ground terminal is the response to Pentagon's preference for single-vendor stack delivery. Comp framing: Iridium (IRDM), Globalstar (now Amazon) on terminals; Planet (PL), Maxar private on satellites. Structure (155M cash + 5.9M YSS shares) implies meaningful stock-based earnout — both sides betting on York's listing path. Less interesting as a standalone deal, more as evidence of accelerating smallsat consolidation.
rounds.company_description: ALL.SPACE: UK manufacturer of multi-orbit phased-array antenna terminals (the Smart Terminal) for satellite communications. Acquired by York Space Systems for $355M to consolidate vertically integrated smallsat plus terminal offerings.

rounds.robotnik_take: Phantom buying TMT for thermal-control IP is the vertical-integration tell for orbital data centers — Phantom Cloud's Block I spacecraft thermal budget is the binary engineering constraint, and owning the radiator stack derisks supply schedule. Comp set: Sophia Space and Lonestar on orbital DC peers, Lumen Orbit on US scale-up, Starcloud on Starship-deployed, Axiom on station-attached compute; Equinix (EQIX) and Iron Mountain (IRM) as terrestrial counters. Terms undisclosed; strategic tuck-in for the constellation roadmap.
rounds.company_description: Thermal Management Technologies: builds thermal control components for spacecraft. Acquired by Phantom Space to support the Phantom Cloud orbital data center constellation thermal needs.

rounds.co_investors: 21 banks under 'Project Apex'
rounds.robotnik_take: Largest IPO filing in history; repricing the entire space stack from launch incumbents (RKLB, ASTS, IRDM) downward. Confidential S-1 with a June 2026 listing target signals SpaceX is reading current public-market multiples favorably ahead of an expected Starlink spin-off. Single largest signal in the 1Q26 dataset.
rounds.company_description: Manufactures and operates orbital launch vehicles (Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Starship) and the Starlink low-earth-orbit broadband satellite constellation. Provides launch services to commercial, government, and NASA customers and direct-to-consumer satellite internet.

rounds.lead_investors: Haisong Capital, CITIC Construction Investment Capital
rounds.co_investors: Cathay Capital, InnoAngel Fund, Anhui Xinhua Group, Zhike Industrial Investment, Kunlun Capital, Lizhe Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: $8.4B in strategic credit from 12 Chinese state banks alongside an undisclosed equity round is sovereign-scale industrial policy — Beijing is funding orbital data centers as the AI-compute counter to Starlink and US space-AI, with bank credit doing the heavy lifting that VC cannot at this magnitude. Comp set: Sophia Space and Lonestar on US/Japan orbital DC peers, Lumen Orbit on US scale, Starcloud on Starship-deployed; Equinix (EQIX) as terrestrial counter. Export controls are the binary geopolitical risk.
rounds.company_description: Chinese orbital data center startup backed by Beijing municipal sci-tech commission. Supported by $8.4B (57.7B yuan) in strategic credit lines from 12 Chinese banks; targets space-based AI compute infrastructure.

rounds.co_investors: Keen Defence and Security, EIC Accelerator, OTB Ventures, HTGF, APEX Ventures, Seraphim, Faber, E2MC, Kirch Ventures, Lennertz & Co., Mätch VC, MBG Baden-Württemberg, Tech Horizons
rounds.robotnik_take: PHOENIX 2 fleet operating under Portugal's ANACOM license is the regulatory moat — being the only European operator with sovereign reentry approval creates structural advantage as EU return-from-orbit demand materializes. Comp set: Varda Space on US pharmaceuticals-return, Inversion Space on US reentry capsules, Outpost Space on cargo return; no European listed peer. Booz Allen-adjacent Keen Defence on the cap table tags this for dual-use orbital-logistics positioning, which is where margins materialize.
rounds.company_description: German earth-to-space-to-earth orbital reentry company building the PHOENIX series of reentry vehicles for cargo return from orbit. Operating recovery missions near the Azores under a Portuguese ANACOM license; targets the European sovereign return-from-orbit market.

rounds.co_investors: InvestEU guarantee
rounds.robotnik_take: EIB's first-ever direct investment in small launchers is the policy-precedent signal — European institutional capital is finally underwriting sovereign-launch capacity at the venture-debt layer, not just equity. Brings 2026 cumulative raise to E210M, the largest year for a European small-launcher. Comp set: Rocket Lab (RKLB) on small-lift cadence, Isar Aerospace and Latitude as European peers, ArianeGroup and Avio (AVIO IM) on state-aligned heavy-lift. MIURA 5 maiden flight execution remains the binary milestone.
rounds.company_description: Spanish launch vehicle company developing MIURA 5, a small reusable launcher for European commercial and government missions. Mitsubishi Electric is a strategic investor anchoring Asian customer access.

rounds.robotnik_take: Rocket Lab (RKLB) completing the Mynaric acquisition at a higher price than originally agreed signals the SDA Tranche 3 contract is the load-bearing economic justification — RKLB cannot win $1.3B in CONDOR Mk3 commitments without owning the laser terminal vendor. Strategic frame is end-to-end vertical integration: RKLB now controls launch, bus, components, and optical comms, mirroring Maxar's pre-acquisition stack. Bullish for RKLB prime positioning, bearish for competing terminal vendors (CACI, BridgeComm, Mbryonics).
rounds.company_description: Mynaric: German manufacturer of laser optical communication terminals for satellite-to-satellite and ground-to-satellite data links. Acquired by Rocket Lab for $155.3M; the CONDOR Mk3 terminal is integrated into Rocket Lab's SDA Tranche 3 contracts.

rounds.robotnik_take: Amazon's first real offensive move in direct-to-cell, paying 90/share cash for the Apple-anchored MSS spectrum and infrastructure. Bearish read-through for AST SpaceMobile (ASTS): Project Kuiper now has the spectrum, the Apple commercial relationship, and the capital base to fight Starlink in D2C, leaving ASTS as the third option in a market that may only fit two. Iridium (IRDM) and Globalstar's pre-deal multiples were the public-market anchors here, both now repriced.
rounds.company_description: Globalstar: operates a satellite communications network with MSS spectrum used by Apple for iPhone and Apple Watch emergency satellite connectivity. Acquired by Amazon for $11.57B in cash to bolster Amazon's Project Kuiper LEO ambitions against Starlink and AST SpaceMobile.

rounds.co_investors: Industrious Ventures, Reliable Properties, Scout VC, Squadra Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Flex Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Washington Harbour Partners leading is the second SDA-infrastructure round from WHP in April after Turion — signals a clear thesis on space domain awareness as Golden Dome procurement scales. Comp set: LeoLabs on radar-based SDA, ExoAnalytic Solutions on optical SDA, Slingshot Aerospace on listed-adjacent peer, NorthStar Earth & Space on Canadian SDA peer. 10,000 unidentified objects out of 35,000 in orbit is the TAM-defining metric; ex-Space Force founder team gives the DoD-channel underwrite. Reads as cleanest pure-play on US SDA buildout.
rounds.company_description: Provides space domain awareness through orbital object identification ('fingerprinting') of the roughly 35,000 objects in orbit. Founded by former US Space Force and Air Force officers; targets defense and Golden Dome adjacent customers.

rounds.lead_investors: Liangxi Sci-Tech Innovation Phase II Fund (Bohua Capital)
rounds.co_investors: Turing Capital, Puhua Capital, Guoxin Guozheng, Xiangjiang State Investment
rounds.robotnik_take: $190M from Chinese state-linked LPs immediately ahead of an A-share IPO is the cleanest case study in how OFAC-designated companies recapitalize inside the Chinese state-financial system. The 2023 Treasury sanctions over alleged Wagner SAR imagery closed Western capital channels; this round shows the Beijing alternative is fully operational. Comp set: Capella Space, ICEYE, Synspective on Western SAR; HEAD Aerospace and MinoSpace as domestic Chinese peers. Bearish read-through for US export-control durability.
rounds.company_description: Chinese commercial satellite manufacturer specializing in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) spacecraft. 38 satellites launched across 21 missions; sanctioned by US Treasury in 2023 for alleged SAR imagery provided to the Wagner Group, and now state-linked.

rounds.lead_investors: Clean Energy Finance Corporation (via Virescent Ventures)
rounds.co_investors: Neglected Climate Opportunities, European Metal Recycling (EMR), Investible, Climate Tech Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: Round upsized from $8M target days after Ascend Elements bankruptcy on April 9 — the distressed-comp signal is the load-bearing piece, with capital rotating from centralized Redwood/Ascend toward smaller distributed alkali-based hydrometallurgical plants. Comp set: Redwood Materials on US centralized recycling, Li-Cycle (post-restructuring) on listed-precedent peer, Cirba Solutions on US private. Alkali process captures 30% more lithium vs acid-based — economics edge that distributed model needs to clear scale-economics gap.
rounds.company_description: Australian lithium-ion battery recycler using an alkali-based hydrometallurgical process. Recovers lithium, cobalt, nickel, copper, and manganese at over 95% efficiency, with up to 30% more lithium capture than acid-based methods. Plant ramping from 960 to 2,000 tpa.

rounds.robotnik_take: Asset-secured debt financing with future equity option is the canonical project-finance hybrid emerging for cement decarb post-DOE OCED grant cancellations — capital is rotating from federal-grant dependence to asset-collateralized debt at the plant level. Comp set: Sublime Systems and Brimstone on US cement-decarb peers, Heirloom on CO2-mineralization, Holcim (HOLN SW) and CRH (CRH) as listed cement-counters. CRH Ventures, Cemex, and TITAN strategic participation locks in offtake — debt-plus-strategic structure is the survivable model for cement decarb in 2026.
rounds.company_description: Canadian company sequestering CO2 from cement kilns to produce low-carbon supplementary cementitious materials. Operates at the Ash Grove Mississauga cement plant with up to 30,000 tpa capacity; strategic backers include CRH, Cemex, and TITAN.

rounds.co_investors: Paper Ventures, JPEG Trading, Mapleblock Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Decentralized GPU compute with an EVM-IDE application layer is a borderline DePIN-AI fit — true infrastructure thesis is the verifiable-inference stack, not CodeXero. Comp set: io.net and Render on GPU DePIN, Gensyn on verifiable AI training, Akash on decentralized compute, Bittensor on subnet-based AI markets. $5M strategic round is dev-tooling capital, not protocol-scale. Application-layer dependency on EVM dApp deployment volume is the binary risk if AI-IDE adoption stalls.
rounds.company_description: Decentralized GPU compute infrastructure platform with verifiable AI execution and modular orchestration. Operates the CodeXero browser-native AI IDE for EVM smart contract deployment.

rounds.co_investors: Fidelity Management & Research, Baillie Gifford, Valor Equity Partners, Tiger Global Management
rounds.robotnik_take: Series H extension brings total H round to $800M and tags Paradigm onto a crossover-heavy IPO-prep syndicate (Fidelity, Baillie Gifford, Tiger, Valor). Crypto-fund participation in autonomous logistics is the tell — Paradigm crossing into physical AI signals private market is treating Zipline as a near-term liquidity event. Comp framing remains thin: no public pure-play, Wing (under GOOGL) and Matternet as private peers a tier below. Houston/Phoenix/Seattle expansion is the test of US suburban economics.
rounds.company_description: Operates an autonomous drone delivery network for medical supplies, retail goods, and food. Started with blood and vaccine delivery in Rwanda and Ghana; now expanding US operations to Houston, Phoenix, and Seattle. Builds both the fixed-wing delivery drones and the operating software stack.

rounds.co_investors: Founderful, 2100VC, Danobat
rounds.robotnik_take: $6.7M seed for an ETH-Zurich spinout running a hybrid 3D-print-plus-CNC robotic cell at industrial scale. Comp set is thin pre-commercial — closest listed analog is Markforged/3D Systems (DDD) on large-format additive plus Hexagon (HXGBY) on inline metrology, but neither integrates the full robotic loop SAEKI is building. Lightbird leading signals deep-tech capital is betting on closed-loop microfactories rather than mega-fabs. Catalyst is the first paying aerospace tier-one order proving multi-material throughput at production rates.
rounds.company_description: SAEKI develops autonomous microfactories that combine large-format 3D printing with robotic CNC machining and inspection in a single closed-loop workflow. The Swiss company targets aerospace, automotive, and construction customers needing large precision components in days rather than weeks.

rounds.robotnik_take: $23.5M seed at the high end of the bracket — CRV and First Round co-leading a Caper-AI-exit team building task-sequenced robotic arms plus a foundation model. Closest listed comps are limited: Symbotic (SYM) on warehouse automation and ABB (ABBNY) on industrial arms, neither building task-conditioned VLA models. The thesis is whether per-task fine-tuning on $5K-class arms beats general-purpose humanoid platforms on near-term ROI. Six months later the round was followed by a $120M Series A with NVIDIA Amazon Samsung — pricing the seed in retrospect at venture conviction levels.
rounds.company_description: Dyna Robotics builds low-cost stationary robotic arms paired with a robotics foundation model called DYNA-1 for repetitive tasks such as food prep, folding, and packaging. The Redwood City team comes out of the Caper AI exit to Instacart.

rounds.co_investors: Sunflower Capital, Costanoa Ventures, Seedcamp
rounds.robotnik_take: $17M seed for the de-facto open-source visualization layer for physical AI — adopted inside Meta Google Hugging Face Unitree workflows. No clean listed comp; closest adjacency is Datadog (DDOG) on observability and Confluent (CFLT) on streaming data, but Rerun is purpose-built for multimodal sensor streams. Point Nine leading signals the data-infrastructure layer is being repriced as a robotics primitive, not a SaaS niche. Catalyst is whether the commercial DB monetizes the existing open-source distribution into seven-figure ARR.
rounds.company_description: Rerun builds open-source visualization tooling plus a commercial database for multimodal robot, drone, and autonomous-vehicle data — video streams, 3D scenes, and time-varying tensors. The Stockholm-based team is making physical-AI data infrastructure a horizontal category.

rounds.robotnik_take: Sub-$1M pre-seed flagged because iHub is the first Indian humanoid maker accepted into NVIDIA's program and is already shipping the Tara Gen-1 into Gulf hospitality contracts. Comp set is thin — listed analogs are Pudu Robotics (private) on hospitality service bots and Bear Robotics on F&B; neither has Indian manufacturing scale.
