Plan to build "India's largest humanoid robotics facility" is binary — either Kerala ramp delivers volume or the round was prematurely flagged.
rounds.company_description: iHub Robotics builds semi-humanoid service robots for hospitality, healthcare, transportation, and customer-service deployments. Its Tara Gen-1 robot ships into UAE and Saudi Arabia, and the company is the first Indian member of NVIDIA's Humanoid Robotics Program.

rounds.co_investors: Draper Associates, Decisive Point Ventures, Perot Jain, Sigmas Group, Evolution VC, BVVC, Habitat Partners, Piedmont Capital Investments, FJ Labs, Revelry Venture Partners, Monte Carlo Capital, Expansion VC, Gaingels
rounds.robotnik_take: $15M seed with Booz Allen's venture arm co-leading — the integrator stamp matters for DoD pipeline. Comp set is the listed defense autonomy basket — Kratos (KTOS), AeroVironment (AVAV), Palantir (PLTR) on the software side — though Scout is earlier on the curve. The thesis is whether a VLA-trained robotics foundation model layered onto small ground/air vehicles converts a contract backlog into a defense-prime platform. Series A came one year later at $100M, validating the seed thesis but pricing the late-2025 entrants out of the cheap window.
rounds.company_description: Scout AI builds unmanned ground and aerial vehicles plus a vision-language-action foundation model called Fury for defense applications. The California team operates prototypes in the Santa Cruz Mountains and holds a multi-contract DoD backlog.

rounds.co_investors: Mirae Asset Venture Investment, Global Brain
rounds.robotnik_take: $14.8M seed — large by Korean robotics standards — for a foundation-model team paired with corporate strategics CJ Logistics LG SK Hyosung. Comp set: Physical Intelligence and Skild on the foundation-model side, Naver (NAVER.KS) on Korean robotics integration. Hashed leading rather than a traditional VC signals crossover capital flowing into physical AI from crypto-native funds. The follow-on $26M Seed 2 in February 2026 priced the conviction higher — combined $41M of seed capital before a labeled Series A is unusual and worth tracking.
rounds.company_description: RLWRLD builds a robotics foundation model that combines large language models with traditional robotics software, trained directly inside operating manufacturing and logistics facilities. The Korean team targets industrial-scale precision and reasoning tasks rather than humanoid form factor.

rounds.co_investors: SNR, Louis Kearns, Joon Sung Park
rounds.robotnik_take: Pre-seed in a sub-segment with almost no clean comps — social companion robots for teens. Listed analogs are weak; Embodied Inc. (private, now dormant) is the cautionary tale, while Hasbro (HAS) and Mattel (MAT) hover near the consumer end. The thesis turns on whether an AI-conversational social robot can find paid distribution before Embodied-style burn forces a shutdown. Sub-$5M raise is appropriate for the pre-commercial stage — the founder team is the asset here, not pricing.
rounds.company_description: Fawn Friends builds AI-powered social robots designed for adolescents to develop emotional intelligence, regulation, and relationship skills through AI-driven conversations. The San Francisco company partners with child development experts on conversation design.

rounds.co_investors: Tapestry, Seedcamp, Tiny.vc, Prototype Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: $8.5M seed with Plural leading — the European hard-tech founder fund increasingly active in robotics. Comp set: ABB (ABBNY) Fanuc (FANUY) and Yaskawa (YASKY) on traditional industrial arms, plus Sereact and Theker on the AI-arm retrofit side. The thesis is whether simulation-first deployment compresses the eight-month integration cycle hard enough to win against the listed primes on per-cell economics. Slovenia base plus customer pull in EU supercar segment is the asymmetric exposure — not yet visible to US capital.
rounds.company_description: Sunrise Robotics builds modular two-armed industrial robots paired with AI models trained in simulation that deploy onto a production line in under 10 weeks versus a typical eight-month integration cycle. The Ljubljana team has LOIs with around 10 customers in supercar, high-performance battery, and consumer electronics manufacturing.

rounds.co_investors: Kfund, JME Ventures, Itnig, Mission VC, s16vc, Mundi Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $21M — Spain's largest seed round ever — for a Barcelona team retrofitting installed industrial arms with adaptive AI. Comp set: Sereact (Series B at $110M) on warehouse adaptive picking, Theker on RaaS-style retrofit. Inditex as both anchor customer and strategic investor is the asymmetric edge; the holding's textile-logistics complex needs flexible automation that the listed prime offerings can't deliver economically. Risk is whether RaaS economics work outside the Inditex flywheel at this seed valuation.
rounds.company_description: Theker Robotics turns standard industrial robots into adaptive AI-driven machines using a deep-learning vision-control stack delivered as Robot-as-a-Service. The Barcelona team is already deployed inside Inditex factory operations and counts the retailer as both customer and investor.

rounds.co_investors: Garage Capital, Todd and Rahul Capital, Lucas Venture Group
rounds.robotnik_take: $5.5M seed for night-shift UV-C ag robots running RaaS in California strawberry country. Comp set: Carbon Robotics (private, Series D weed control) and listed John Deere (DE) on the autonomous-tractor end; the closest pure-play pricing comp is Bear Flag Robotics pre-acquisition. Thesis is whether UV-C cuts chemical-pesticide spend hard enough to drive 100-acre per-deployment economics, and whether the strawberry-specific edge generalizes to other high-value row crops.
rounds.company_description: TRIC Robotics deploys autonomous tractor-sized robots called Luna that use UV-C light and vacuum to treat strawberry fields for fungal disease and pests without chemical pesticides. The San Luis Obispo team operates a Robotics-as-a-Service fleet at night, targeting 40-50 units in California strawberry farms.

rounds.co_investors: Airtree, Xtal, Skip Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: $4.5M pre-seed flagged as one of Australia's largest pre-seed rounds. Direct comp is Rerun ($17M seed for Stockholm-based physical-AI data infra) plus US adjacent player Neuracore. Blackbird leading rather than a US generalist fund signals the data-layer thesis is now defended regionally. Angel roster includes operators from Tesla Waymo Carbon Robotics — strong signal on the founder. Thesis is whether the natural-language query surface on robot data is durable as foundation-model providers extend into the data tooling layer.
rounds.company_description: Alloy is a robotics-data platform that lets teams organize, search, and analyze multimodal robot data using natural language, claiming up to 90% reduction in data-processing time. Early Australian customers include Hullbot, Breaker, and Greenroom Robotics.

rounds.co_investors: Humba Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners
rounds.robotnik_take: $8.65M seed at very-young-founder pricing — Lachy Groom (Physical Intelligence co-founder) anchoring with Lightspeed plus angels from Tesla SpaceX Anduril. Comp set on delivery drones: Zipline (private, late-stage), Wing (Alphabet subsidiary), Matternet (private). Airbound's claim is structural: blended-wing-body efficiency drives a one-cent target that Zipline's fixed-wing platform can't reach. Indian first market plus medical-delivery pilot is the wedge. Risk is regulatory and operational, not technical — drone delivery scale is bottlenecked on airspace approvals not aerodynamics.
rounds.company_description: Airbound builds ultra-light blended-wing-body delivery drones that launch vertically tail-sitter-style and fly horizontally. The Bengaluru team, led by 20-year-old founder Naman Pushp, targets one-cent unit-economics on parcel delivery via aerodynamic efficiency.

rounds.lead_investors: Matrix Partners China, Xiaomi Strategic Investment
rounds.co_investors: L2F Light Source Entrepreneurs Fund, Galbot
rounds.robotnik_take: $10M seed — the largest seed in China's open-source humanoid sector. Matrix Partners China plus Xiaomi Strategic Investment co-leading signals corporate consumer-electronics capital is treating open-source humanoid as a developer-distribution play, not a product-revenue play. Comp set: Unitree (private, more mature closed-source) on bipedal hardware, plus US analogs like K-Scale Labs (open hardware seed). Thesis is whether open-source distribution converts to enterprise integration revenue.
rounds.company_description: RoboParty is a Shanghai-based startup building a fully open-source bipedal humanoid robot called ROBOTO ORIGIN, with hardware designs, low-level control code, and Sim2Real solutions all publicly available. Founded by 21-year-old Huang Yi.

rounds.co_investors: Blue Sky Capital, AIC Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Sub-$2M pre-seed for a UC Berkeley/Virginia Tech tactile-sensing spinout. Comp set is genuinely thin — listed analogs are stretched: TE Connectivity (TEL) on industrial sensors, plus private players SynTouch (acquired by Tekscan) and Contactile (Australia) on robotic tactile fingertips. The Sensetics edge is the recording-and-replay framing rather than pure sensing — turning touch into a transmissible medium. Thesis turns on whether surgical-robot and humanoid-hand OEMs adopt a third-party tactile stack at scale.
rounds.company_description: Sensetics develops a touch-sensing platform combining Touch Signature programmable fabrics with AI-powered tactile capture and replay tools. The Princeton team is targeting robotic arms, surgical tools, wearables, and VR/AR touch controllers.

rounds.robotnik_take: $2M pre-seed flagged because of Tim Draper anchoring solo — typical Draper signal for early hardware bets. Comp set in construction robotics: All3 (already in dataset, $25M seed for legged construction platform), Sitegeist (€4M pre-seed concrete renovation), plus listed Caterpillar (CAT) Komatsu (KMTUY) on equipment automation. UAE-first commercial wedge is unusual and defendable given Gulf labor economics. Risk is the simulation-to-physical gap at masonry tolerances — block-laying isn't trivial.
rounds.company_description: Buildroid AI develops simulation-first construction robotics, integrating specialized and general-purpose robots into contractor workflows starting with block-laying robots using BIM-to-BUILD simulation. The US team is targeting UAE construction with deployments planned for Q2 2026.

rounds.co_investors: firstminute capital, Heracles Capital, Clem Delangue
rounds.robotnik_take: $3M pre-seed in the same data-infrastructure category as Rerun ($17M) and Alloy ($4.5M) — three teams attacking the same pain point from different angles. Neuracore's edge is the academic distribution plus the Clem Delangue check, which echoes Hugging Face's open-source-to-enterprise playbook. Listed adjacencies are stretched: Datadog (DDOG) on observability, Snowflake (SNOW) on platform monetization of data. Thesis turns on whether being the standard learning stack inside universities converts to commercial pull as those PhDs ship into industry.
rounds.company_description: Neuracore is a London-based cloud-native robot-learning platform that lets robotics teams move from data collection to deployed ML models in days rather than months. Founded by Stephen James of Imperial College London; deployed across 50+ commercial and academic robotics organizations.

rounds.co_investors: Abstract Ventures, MaC Venture Capital, Box Group, Icehouse Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $4.24M pre-seed for a Tesla-Autopilot-and-DeepMind-pedigree team building parallel simulation infrastructure. Comp set: Nvidia (NVDA) Isaac Sim on the proprietary side, plus private players Foretellix and Applied Intuition on the AV simulation pricing curve. Antioch's pitch is generalizing the Tesla/Waymo internal simulation stack to every robotics team as a third-party. Four months later the seed priced at $60M post — pricing the pre-seed conviction at meaningful gains while keeping the company in the seed-tier still.
rounds.company_description: Antioch is a robotics simulation infrastructure platform that lets teams build, test, and deploy autonomous systems entirely in software, creating thousands of digital twins in parallel and integrating with CI/CD workflows. Co-founded by Stanford graduates with ex-Tesla, DeepMind, and Meta Reality Labs backgrounds.

rounds.robotnik_take: Pre-seed at the threshold — flagged because hull-fouling drives an estimated 9% of shipping fuel waste, a clearly bounded TAM in a regulated sector. Comp set: Greensea IQ (private) and Notilo Plus (acquired) on subsea inspection robots, plus listed shipping adjacencies Maersk (AMKBY) on operator demand and PSI Software on fleet optimization. Solo founder plus solo lead is high beta — execution risk is the binding constraint, not technology or market pull.
rounds.company_description: ScrubMarine is a UK maritime robotics startup developing an autonomous system for cleaning and inspecting ship hulls. Founded by 21-year-old engineer Rohith Devanathan and targets the shipping industry's hull-fouling fuel-efficiency problem.

rounds.co_investors: Day One Capital, Prototype Capital, SDAC Ventures, TinyVC, RoboStrategy
rounds.robotnik_take: $7.2M — Hungary's largest pre-seed ever — for a robotics manufacturing-process play rather than a robot OEM. Comp set is thin: closest listed adjacency is Harmonic Drive (private) on actuator manufacturing, plus private peer Wandelbots on robot-component flexibility. The angel roster from OpenAI Hugging Face ETH Zurich Northwestern is the strongest signal in this batch — implies the technical thesis cleared deep AI/robotics scrutiny. Thesis is whether the manufacturing-process IP is licensable or whether they go full robot-platform vertical.
rounds.company_description: Allonic develops an automated 3D tissue braiding manufacturing process that weaves robotic bodies in a continuous process rather than assembling hundreds of precision parts. The Budapest team is targeting manipulators, hands, and grippers, with arms and full-body systems as later expansion.

rounds.co_investors: BYT Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: $1.1M seed — at the lower threshold, flagged for sector category. Comp set: Gecko Robotics (private, unicorn-status on industrial inspection) and ABB (ABBNY) plus listed AOI player Cognex (CGNX) on machine vision. India inspection-robotics density is rising — both Octobotics and Armatrix raising within weeks of each other in February signals a regional cluster forming. Risk is execution at scale in nuclear/oil-and-gas industrial customer cycles.
rounds.company_description: Octobotics builds AI-enabled non-destructive testing inspection robots designed for harsh industrial environments. The Indian team targets industrial asset inspection and rail automation.

rounds.co_investors: Garage Capital, Entrepreneurs First
rounds.robotnik_take: $7.5M seed with Plural leading — the second Plural-led robotics seed in this sweep after Sunrise Robotics. Comp set on ag automation: listed Deere (DE) AGCO (AGCO) CNH (CNHI) on tractor automation; private peers Carbon Robotics (Series D weed control) and Burro (Series A in-field carts). Upside's edge is fertilizer-specific economics — $150/acre savings is a hard-to-fake operator-pull metric. Plural plus Clearpath founders is meaningful — Clearpath-network capital backs Canadian ag automation.
rounds.company_description: Upside Robotics builds lightweight solar-powered autonomous robots that deliver precise fertilizer doses to crop root zones, currently focused on corn farms. The Waterloo team has cut customer fertilizer use by ~70% with 100% retention, scaling from 70 to 3,000+ acres in 18 months.

rounds.co_investors: Bass Ventures, 500 Global
rounds.robotnik_take: $1M seed at the threshold — flagged because of the actuator-first thesis. Index's CEO Seung-hoon Shin explicitly frames hardware not AI as the binding constraint for humanoid commercialization. Comp set: Harmonic Drive (Tokyo: 6324) on listed actuators, AILOS Robotics (already in dataset, €3.5M seed) on European actuator startups, plus private Reflex Robotics on wheeled mobile manipulation. Korea's robotics components depth is the under-priced moat — Samsung LG Hanwha all sourcing locally.
rounds.company_description: Index Robotics develops upper-body humanoid robots built around proprietary high-precision actuators that resolve gear-reducer limitations. The Korean team's INDEX01 prototype targets logistics handling, machining support, and precision assembly tasks.

rounds.robotnik_take: €4M (~$4.4M) pre-seed for a TUM spinout attacking concrete renovation — a labor-bottlenecked, regulation-heavy adjacent to All3 (already in dataset, $25M seed construction robotics). Comp set on infrastructure renovation: listed Heidelberg Materials (HEI) on concrete demand-side, Caterpillar (CAT) on heavy equipment, plus private competitor Renovai. Sitegeist's edge is operating on existing structures without pre-existing CAD/BIM. Munich plus b2venture suggests strong DACH industrial customer access.
rounds.company_description: Sitegeist Robotics develops AI-enabled robots for concrete removal in bridge, tunnel, and building renovation work. The Munich TUM spinout uses advanced perception, AI-based decision support, and adaptive control to operate on existing structures without pre-existing 3D models.

rounds.co_investors: Inuka Capital, Boundless Ventures, Boost VC, Turbostart, gradCapital
rounds.robotnik_take: $2.1M pre-seed for snake-arm industrial inspection — paired with Octobotics ($1.1M seed three weeks earlier) signals an Indian inspection-robotics regional cluster. Comp set: Gecko Robotics (US unicorn) on industrial wall-climbing inspection, OC Robotics (acquired) on confined-space arms. The hyper-redundant arm geometry is competitively differentiated for nuclear and reactor work. Risk concentration is industrial certification cycles — multi-year qualification before scaled deployment is the bottleneck.
rounds.company_description: Armatrix develops hyper-redundant snake-like robotic arms for inspection and maintenance inside hazardous confined industrial spaces — tanks, reactors, engines. The Bengaluru team serves shipbuilding, nuclear, oil and gas, and aviation customers.

rounds.co_investors: CJ Logistics, Kakao Investment, Lotte Ventures, Hanwha Asset Management, Mirae Asset-Emart Investment Fund I, Hyosung Ventures, Smilegate Investment, T Investment, Hashed Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $26M Seed II at 11 months post Seed 1 — the strategic-investor stack (CJ Kakao Lotte Hanwha Hyosung) is the asymmetric edge versus pure-financial peers. Comp set: Physical Intelligence (Series C at $5B) and Skild AI (Series C at $14B) on the foundation-model side, plus listed Naver (035420.KS) and SK Telecom (017670.KS) on Korean strategic-investor signaling. The cumulative $41M of seed across 11 months without a labeled Series A is unusual structuring — likely a deliberate decision to keep dilution in the strategic-capital lane before institutional pricing.
rounds.company_description: RLWRLD builds a robotics foundation model that combines large language models with traditional robotics software, trained directly inside operating manufacturing and logistics facilities. This Seed 2 brings total seed funding to $41M.

rounds.co_investors: Blue Asva Varenya Fund, FBC Venture Partners, Spearhead Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: $3.3M seed at $29.4M post-money — Indian humanoid pricing benchmark with serial-founder-from-ShareChat-exit pedigree. Comp set: General Autonomy is one of the first labeled Indian humanoid plays alongside iHub Robotics (pre-seed sub-$1M) and Addverb (private, more mature). Listed comparables don't exist locally — closest is Tata Group robotics initiatives. Thesis is whether Indian labor-cost arbitrage on humanoid manufacturing offers cost-of-build edge versus US/China humanoid leaders even pre-foundation-model.
rounds.company_description: General Autonomy builds AI-driven humanoid robots and robot dogs to automate labor-intensive workflows for Indian factories and warehouses. Co-founded in 2023 by ex-ShareChat founders Farid Ahsan and Bhanu Pratap Singh.

rounds.co_investors: Sisyphus, Antler, StartupLab, Off Piste, Andøya Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $5.4M pre-seed described as one of the largest in Nordic defense-tech history. Comp set: Anduril (private) and Helsing (private, European) on the broader defense-AI side, plus listed BAE Systems (BAESY) Saab (SAABF) on European primes. Stendr's Sky Mavis pedigree is unusual — crypto-native founder reentering defense-tech is a 2026-era pattern worth flagging. Thesis turns on whether European sovereignty mandates from the 2025-2026 EU defense package convert into Stendr orders ahead of incumbents.
rounds.company_description: Stendr is a Norwegian defense-technology company building AI-powered drone detection and counter-drone solutions as a vertically integrated hardware-plus-software stack designed for European sovereignty. Founded by Aleksander Leonard Larsen, formerly COO of Sky Mavis.

rounds.co_investors: Peter Rive, Frank Thieser, Florian Seibel, Koro Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: £4M (~$5.4M) seed for autonomous surface vessels — Seraphim Space leading signals space-and-defense capital crossover into maritime autonomy. Co-investor mix Peter Rive (SolarCity co-founder) plus Quantum Systems founders is a strong technical-operator signal. Comp set: Saildrone (private, more mature) on the ASV side, plus listed Kongsberg (KOG.OL) BAE (BAESY) on the European naval primes. Already has commercial deliveries in April plus initial defense customers — that's late-seed traction at seed pricing.
rounds.company_description: Online Oceans builds autonomous solar-powered surface vessels and a fleet command platform for defense and maritime security, currently focused on anti-submarine warfare, subsea infrastructure protection, and border security. UK-headquartered, founded 2025.
rounds.policy_exposure: EU defense procurement; UK defense procurement

rounds.co_investors: Main Sequence
rounds.robotnik_take: $9M seed with Bessemer leading — first major US-fund check into an Australian defense robotics software play. Main Sequence's prior $2M pre-seed (early 2025) was a signal, this seed is the validation. Comp set: Anduril Lattice (private) and Palantir (PLTR) on the multi-domain coordination layer, plus Scale AI (private) on the data-plus-software defense pattern. The voice-as-control-interface is differentiated against the listed primes' fixed-station coordination paradigms. Catalyst is US DoD pilot conversion.
rounds.company_description: Breaker develops AI-powered software letting military operators coordinate autonomous systems across air, land, and sea via voice commands — managing teams of up to 100 robots per operator. The Sydney-headquartered company runs its software onboard each robot to operate in communications-denied environments.

rounds.co_investors: Cambium Capital, Vsquared Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $23M seed for commercial-scale superconducting compute — first credible non-quantum cryogenic logic play since Northrop Grumman's RSFQ era stalled. Comp set is thin: closest public proxies are NVDA + INTC for power-per-watt benchmarks, with Pat Gelsinger on the board signaling pedigree but no near-term offtake. 25× efficiency claim is bench-only; full system economics depend on whether He cryo CAPEX scales with rack density. We're skeptical until 2026 chip tape-out.
rounds.company_description: Develops superconducting compute chips using niobium-titanium nitride (NbTiN) cooled by standard helium cryogenic equipment, targeting AI, HPC, and quantum-classical hybrid workloads. Claims 25× performance-per-watt over leading CMOS chips, net of cooling overhead. First basic chip targeted for end of 2026.

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: $2.5M pre-seed for European-built agentic EDA — comp set is ChipAgents (now $50M Series A1 at scale) and Cognichip ($93M cumulative), both US-based. Chipmind is the smallest, latest, and most explicitly verification-focused. Strategic frame: SNPS and CDNS are racing to own this layer natively (ChipStack, Questa One); a $2.5M pre-seed has to ship product before incumbents close the gap. ETH founders + 20-tape-out track record is the moat.
rounds.company_description: Develops "design-aware" AI agents that integrate with existing EDA workflows to automate RTL design, verification, and tape-out preparation tasks, with stated goal of cutting engineer time on repetitive low-level tasks by ~40%. Founded by two ETH Zurich PhDs with 20+ chip tape-outs combined. First European pure-play in agentic EDA.

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: $20M seed at unicorn-grade ambition — Koduri's third act after Intel GPU exit, betting GPU IP licensing follows Arm's CPU playbook. Comp set is ARM (public, $130B+ mcap) and never-public competitors (Imagination). MediaTek as lead signals real customer intent for mobile/edge; the open question is whether OXPython actually runs CUDA workloads at competitive perf vs the native NVDA stack. Brand premium > tech maturity at this stage.
rounds.company_description: Founded by Raja Koduri (ex-Intel/AMD/Apple GPU architect), Oxmiq licenses modular GPU IP (OXCORE) and chiplet architecture (OXQUILT) with native Python/CUDA compatibility through OXPython, targeting edge-to-datacenter compute. First software revenue recorded in 2025. Positioned as "the Arm of GPUs."

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: $4.15M seed for analog-EDA copilot — comp set: Astrus (Canada, $8M Khosla seed, also physics-aware AI for analog) and Cognichip (US, $33M+$60M, broader scope). Maieutic is the cheapest entry point and India's first credible bet in EDA-AI; Endiya + Exfinity is a respectable domestic deeptech syndicate but lacks the US-VC distribution Cognichip enjoys. Analog automation remains the highest-value, lowest-penetration EDA segment — SNPS/CDNS have not cracked it natively.
rounds.company_description: Develops a generative-AI copilot specifically for analog integrated circuit design, targeting the still-manual portions of analog/mixed-signal layout that resist conventional EDA automation. Founders are veteran analog designers with 70+ semiconductor patents and >1B units shipped between them. India-headquartered with global commercial intent.

rounds.co_investors: StepStone Group, Celesta Capital, Xora Innovation, Qualcomm Ventures, Cota Capital, MVP Ventures, Stanford University
rounds.robotnik_take: $100M "seed" is structural, not stage — closer to a stealth Series A with seed-style preferred. Comp set: NVDA Spectrum-X (proprietary, dominant), AVGO (Tomahawk silicon switching), MRVL (Innovium acquisition lineage). Upscale's open-standards thesis (UALink, UE) is a direct bet against NVDA lock-in; the syndicate (Mayfield + Qualcomm Ventures + StepStone) signals corporate-strategic intent. Already raised $200M Series A within months — round structure is more about capital-markets optics than capital need.
rounds.company_description: Designs open-standard AI networking silicon, systems, and a SONiC/SAI-based network operating system for ultra-low-latency AI fabrics. Built on UALink and Ultra Ethernet open standards. Incubated by Auradine; led by Innovium/Cavium/Marvell veterans. Positioned as the open-stack alternative to NVIDIA Spectrum-X / Mellanox.

rounds.co_investors: Lux Capital, DCVC, Sequoia Capital, Future Ventures, Databricks, Jeff Bezos
rounds.robotnik_take: $475M seed at $4.5B is the largest "seed" in semiconductor history — categorical noise; round label reflects pre-product status, not capital structure. Comp set is empty: closest analogs are Cerebras and Etched at later rounds, no neuromorphic incumbents at scale (Mythic wound down 2022). Rao's prior exits (MosaicML $1.3B to DDOG, Nervana to INTC) buy execution credibility; a16z+Lightspeed co-lead with $10M founder check signals conviction. Single-bet exposure for the sector — outcome binary.
rounds.company_description: Founded by Naveen Rao (ex-Databricks AI head, MosaicML founder, Nervana → Intel) to build neuromorphic / analog-inspired computers targeting AI energy efficiency, modeled on biological systems' compute-per-joule envelope. First $475M tranche of planned $1B round; only public AI-hardware "seed" at $4.5B post-money valuation in 2025.

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: $35M seed at $750M post — Sequoia paying full founder premium for the AlphaChip team. Comp set: Cognichip ($93M cumulative), Astrus ($8M Khosla), Chipmind ($2.5M); Ricursive is the deepest pedigree, broadest scope (architecture-to-PD), highest valuation. Series A ($300M / $4B post) closed within 8 weeks — fastest deeptech markup of 2025-26. SNPS / CDNS native AI is the structural competitor; whether incumbent-built or startup-built EDA-AI wins depends on data access, not models.
rounds.company_description: Frontier AI lab founded by Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini (creators of Google AlphaChip) targeting AI-driven automation across the full semiconductor design stack: architecture, RTL, verification, physical design. Built around recursive feedback loop where AI designs chips that train more advanced AI models. First product still pre-disclosure.

rounds.co_investors: Flanders Future Techfund, Wallonie Entreprendre, Sambrinvest, Noshaq, InvestBW, Drysdale Ventures, Kima Ventures, Eurazeo, XAnge, Vector Gestion, imec.xpand, imec
rounds.robotnik_take: €37M ($42.9M) seed extension brings total seed to €57M — comp set: SK hynix HBM stacked memory (incumbent), Niobium ($23M Seed, cryo memory), AheadComputing (compute layer only). Vertical Compute is the only credible European 3D memory-on-logic play. imec lineage is the moat: process integration access most startups can't replicate. Strategic frame: memory bandwidth is now the binding constraint on AI training, and HBM is supply-constrained through 2027 — any credible alternative architecture commands premium even pre-product.
rounds.company_description: imec spin-off (Belgium) developing 3D-integrated memory stacked directly on compute logic within a single 300mm wafer manufacturing process. Reduces memory–compute distance from cm to nm scale, targeting AI inference / HBM-class workloads with chiplet form factor. First test chip taped-out in 2025.

rounds.co_investors: Earth & Beyond, Surround Ventures, Israel Innovation Authority
rounds.robotnik_take: $9M seed for superconducting million-qubit cryo-integration — comp set: IBM Quantum (incumbent, integrated stack), IONQ + RGTI (public, sub-1k physical qubits), QuEra, PsiQuantum (private $1B+). QuamCore's distinct claim is on-chip control electronics that eliminate the cabling explosion that plagues IBM's roadmap past 1k qubits. Series A ($26M Aug 2025) closed within 5 months — pace of pull suggests technical milestone, not just narrative. Single-bet, binary.
rounds.company_description: Israeli quantum compute startup developing superconducting quantum processor architecture engineered to integrate up to 1 million qubits in a single cryostat, reducing inter-qubit cabling by >1000× via on-chip control electronics. Founded by Mobileye / Technion / Weizmann veterans. Out of stealth March 2025.

rounds.co_investors: OVNI Capital, Kima Ventures, IXCORE Group, Better Angle, EPSL VC, Bpifrance
rounds.robotnik_take: €7.5M ($8.7M) pre-seed at 5 months old — French quantum-supply-chain play that complements QuamCore's on-chip approach from the other direction (rack-level wiring vs. control-electronics integration). Comp set: Bluefors (cryostat incumbent, private), Quantcore (UK, niobium components). Heartcore lead with full France 2030 / Bpifrance ecosystem support is structurally similar to how Pasqal scaled. Pre-commercial; binding constraint is whether IBM/Rigetti/Google adopt third-party cryo wiring or keep in-house.
rounds.company_description: Paris-based quantum infrastructure startup developing dense, low-thermal-load cryogenic interconnects that enable 1000× more qubits per dilution refrigerator. Targets the wiring bottleneck that caps superconducting quantum systems at a few hundred qubits today. Founded May 2025 by ETH Zürich quantum PhD and ex-Bain consultant.

rounds.lead_investors: PXN Ventures, Blackfinch Ventures, Scottish Enterprise
rounds.co_investors: Quantum Exponential, STAC
rounds.robotnik_take: £2.5M ($3.4M) seed for UK-sovereign superconducting components — comp set: Quantum Motion, Oxford Instruments NanoScience (Imperial-adjacent), no direct US/EU analog. Strategic frame is post-CHIPS / post-EU Chips Act: every major bloc now wants domestic quantum supply. Quantcore is the smallest pure-play but the only one with active fab output at Glasgow JWNC. Government-grant ratio (Scottish Enterprise co-lead) signals policy-grade derisking, not commercial pull.
rounds.company_description: University of Glasgow spin-out building the only UK-domestic manufacturing line for niobium-based superconducting components (processors, resonators, sensors) for quantum computing, secure comms, and medical imaging. Operates from James Watt Nanofabrication Centre. Sovereign-supply-chain positioning under UK National Quantum Strategy.

rounds.co_investors: Faber, BOM, PhotonDelta
rounds.robotnik_take: €4.75M ($4.9M) seed for III-V-on-silicon photonics integration — comp set: Ayar Labs (US, $300M Series D), Lightmatter (US, growth), Aledia (FR, microLED-adjacent). PHOTON IP is the smallest in the photonic-integration cohort but sits in the Eindhoven PhotonDelta cluster, the only EU silicon-photonics ecosystem at scale. Rebrand to Photon Bridge 9 months later suggests pivot or refocus; rate of derisking remains pre-commercial.
rounds.company_description: Eindhoven-based silicon photonics startup developing process to integrate active III-V materials (indium phosphide) onto silicon substrates for energy-efficient photonic engines used in datacenter optical interconnects and sensing. Founded 2020; €2M+ in prior EIC grants. Later rebranded to Photon Bridge in Sep 2025.

rounds.co_investors: Sam Altman, Alex Wang (Scale AI), Trevor Blackwell (Y Combinator)
rounds.robotnik_take: $9M seed for VCSEL-based photonic compute — divergent bet vs. the dominant silicon-photonics path (Ayar Labs, Lightmatter, NcodiN). Comp set is mostly negative: every other photonic-interconnect startup uses heterogeneous Si + III-V; Volantis claims VCSEL direct modulation is the path forward. Founder-backed by Altman pre-public commitment to the AI infra thesis (2022) signals high-conviction angel layer, but the round lacks a named institutional lead — a structural risk flag for Series A pricing.
rounds.company_description: California silicon-photonics startup developing photonic interconnects using directly-modulated VCSELs (vertical cavity surface-emitting lasers) integrated with on-chip optical waveguides — explicitly positioned as a departure from conventional silicon photonics. Targets AI datacenter inter-chip bandwidth bottleneck. Sam Altman has backed since April 2022 (pre-stealth).

rounds.co_investors: Foothill Ventures, Uncork Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: $6M seed for compound-semi chiplet integration in RF — comp set: MACOM (public), Qorvo (public), and emerging private MMICs (Skywater, Wolfspeed RF). PseudolithIC's positioning is the chiplet-era response to fully-integrated MMICs: silicon for digital + III-V chiplets for RF front-end. UCSB lineage and Entrada (semi-specialist) lead suggests technical proof; the win condition is GaN-on-Si yield economics at scale. Pre-commercial.
rounds.company_description: UCSB-rooted RF chiplet startup integrating compound-semiconductor (GaN, GaAs, InP) chiplets with silicon substrates for high-performance wireless products — millimeter-wave power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers — targeting 5G/6G, satellite communications, aerospace. ~15-person team in Santa Barbara.

rounds.co_investors: Entrada Ventures, Berkeley SkyDeck, J-Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $5.2M seed for satcom beamforming silicon — comp set: Qualcomm (incumbent), Anokiwave (acquired by Qorvo), and the public satcom names (IRDM, ASTS) that consume this kind of phased-array IC. Oso's edge is academic — Berkeley's phased-array research lineage produced Sapient Networks (acq Broadcom) and others. Engine Ventures lead signals real DoD/dual-use overlap. 4× efficiency claim depends on production yield, not architecture; pre-commercial.
rounds.company_description: UC Berkeley spinout designing low-loss beamforming chipsets for phased-array antennas targeting SATCOM, 5G mmWave, and radar systems. Proprietary "Combiner-First" architecture for phase shifting and signal combining claims up to 4× efficiency improvement vs. conventional phased-array silicon. Founded 2022.

rounds.co_investors: Pradeep Sindhu, 1517 Fund, Drive Capital, Alumni Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $8M seed for physics-aware analog-EDA — direct comp: Maieutic ($4.15M, India) and Cognichip ($93M cumulative, US, broader scope). Astrus's claim is the deepest RL training pedigree (Müller-trained) targeting the hardest unautomated EDA segment (analog layout). Khosla lead is structurally bullish for AI-on-EDA; Pradeep Sindhu (Juniper founder) adds chip-industry credibility. Strategic frame: analog layout is where SNPS+CDNS revenue per design is highest and incumbent tools are weakest — biggest white-space in EDA.
rounds.company_description: Toronto/Waterloo AI startup building physics-aware reinforcement-learning models specifically for analog chip layout — generates thousands of candidate layouts in seconds against months of manual engineering today. Co-founders include former satellite-sensor chip designer and reinforcement-learning researcher trained by AlphaGo's Martin Müller.

rounds.co_investors: LetsVenture Angel Fund, Sun Icon Ventures, MyAsiaVC, Whitepine Investments, Jain Oncor
rounds.robotnik_take: ₹25 Cr ($2.75M) seed for edge-AI silicon at Indian fabless rate card — comp set: Mindgrove (India, $10M cumulative), BigEndian ($9M cumulative), HrdWyr ($13M Series A). Sensesemi's edge is multi-modal integration (AI + wireless + analog) for medical/industrial verticals where DLI subsidies move volume. Founded 2014 but first capital raise — atypical late seed for an 11-year-old company suggests prior bootstrapping + DLI grant runway; commercial chip not yet taped out.
rounds.company_description: Bengaluru-based fabless designer of integrated edge-AI silicon combining AI inferencing, wireless mesh connectivity, and precision analog signal processing on a single chip. Targets industrial IoT, automotive ADAS, and medical devices (cardiac monitoring, smart drug delivery). DLI-approved under India's Design Linked Incentive scheme. First two test chips tape-out planned 2026.

rounds.co_investors: Geodesic Alliance Fund, Oregon Venture Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: $15.5M seed for system-level chiplet form-factor — comp set: NVIDIA NVL72 (productized rack-scale, $30k+ per node), AMD MI300X racks, no startup analog at this integration level. Mueon's "Cubelet" framing is system-scale chiplet, closer to a custom motherboard architecture than a chip — value capture depends on whether hyperscalers buy modular units or just custom-design their own. Intel Capital lead is a clear strategic-corp signal; team pedigree (Intel/AMD veterans) carries the round.
rounds.company_description: Portland Oregon startup developing modular stackable "Cubelets" that integrate compute, memory, power delivery, and thermal management into a single physical unit — replacing rack-of-servers form factor for AI datacenters. Team includes shipped-billions-of-units veterans in CPU, GPU, memory architecture, power delivery, and IO design from prior Intel/AMD generations.

rounds.co_investors: Silicon Roundabout Ventures, Phasechange, SANDS, Superlative
rounds.robotnik_take: $3M pre-seed for reconfigurable photolithography — comp set: ASML (incumbent, photolith but for silicon), Heidelberg Instruments (private, maskless lithography). Cnuic's claim is reconfigurable / 3D / multi-material photonic-chip patterning at scale — adjacent rather than competitive to ASML's silicon EUV. Tensor + Blank Space lead signals high-conviction seed, but the address-market (photonic-chip fabs) is still small in 2026. Pre-commercial; binding constraint is fab adoption, not technology.
rounds.company_description: Edinburgh, Scotland startup developing reconfigurable, light-based photolithography device — a working prototype that uses structured-light properties to enable rapid 3D-controlled production of photonic chips, metalenses, AR/VR waveguides, and 3D photonic crystals. Targets the photonic-chip manufacturing bottleneck.

rounds.co_investors: First Momentum Ventures, Mätch VC, Balnord
rounds.robotnik_take: €5M ($5.8M) seed for 800V HVDC power ICs targeting AI datacenter racks — comp set: Empower Semiconductor ($140M+ Series D, IVR incumbent), Navitas (NVTS, GaN power), Vertical Semiconductor ($11M seed, vGaN). Skycore is the only Denmark-domiciled power-semi seed in 2025, leveraging Northern European wind-power-conversion expertise. Strategic frame: 800V HVDC is the rack-architecture transition NVDA/AMD will force across hyperscalers post-2026; first credible power-IC vendors win 2-3 year incumbency.
rounds.company_description: Danish startup with silicon-validated Power IC platform engineered for emerging 800V High-Voltage DC (HVDC) AI datacenter architectures — addresses the physical limits of 54VDC distribution when racks exceed 200kW. First focus is rack-level power conversion for hyperscale AI racks.

rounds.co_investors: Quantonation, HCVC, Founderful, Innosuisse
rounds.robotnik_take: $12M seed for wafer-scale 2D-material integration — comp set: ASML / AMAT / LRCX as deposition+lithography incumbents (none of which directly handle nanomaterial transfer at wafer scale). Chiral is positioned as the "next ASML" for post-silicon (Sifted's framing), which is overclaim — but the underlying equipment niche is real: every credible post-CMOS transistor candidate requires sub-micron precise 2D-material placement, and nobody has automated it. ETH+Empa lineage is genuine deep-tech moat; commercial timeline is 5+ years out.
rounds.company_description: ETH Zurich + Empa spin-off (Switzerland) developing robotic wafer-scale nanomaterial integration platform — automated, contamination-free placement of 2D materials (graphene, transition-metal dichalcogenides, hexagonal boron nitride) into silicon wafers for post-silicon transistors. Sub-micron alignment, room-temperature transfer. Founded 2023.

rounds.co_investors: AgFunder, MANN+HUMMEL
rounds.robotnik_take: $6.6M seed for far-UVC PIC — adjacent semiconductor application; closest comp is GE Current and the bulk far-UVC bulb incumbents (Ushio), no fabless-chip analog. Uviquity's positioning straddles photonics + life-sciences supply chain; MANN+HUMMEL (filtration) as strategic co-investor signals industrial-offtake intent. Thin comp set — true niche bet. Pre-commercial; binding constraint is regulatory adoption (FDA, EPA), not silicon.
rounds.company_description: Develops solid-state far-UVC (200-230nm) semiconductor light sources via proprietary photonic integrated circuit that couples blue laser into frequency-doubling waveguides — single-chip alternative to bulb-based far-UVC for chemical-free disinfection of air, food, water. Founded 2022.

rounds.co_investors: Foothill Ventures, M Ventures, Cerberus Ventures, Raptor Group
rounds.robotnik_take: $18M seed for coherent-lite AI datacenter optics — comp set: Marvell ($24M DustPhotonics acq for ~$1.3B in 2025), Broadcom Tomahawk-class silicon, Coherent + Lumentum (legacy coherent). Lucidean's framing is the gap between high-power coherent (long-haul) and low-power IMDD (datacenter intra-rack) — a $5-10B addressable market once 1.6T+ AI fabrics scale. KDT (Koch family deeptech) lead signals patient capital for fab-process roadmap.
rounds.company_description: Santa Barbara, CA AI interconnect company developing 3.2 / 6.4 Tbps coherent optical transceivers for AI datacenter fabrics. CohZero platform is a "coherent-lite" architecture targeting coherent-class reach and signal integrity at IMDD-class power and cost. Founded by UCSB compound-semiconductor / optical-link veterans (Schow, Coldren academic co-founders).

rounds.co_investors: Systemiq Capital, Aero X Ventures, Trenches Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: $30M seed for chip-to-grid datacenter power architecture — comp set: Empower Semiconductor ($140M+ Series D), Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR public), Vicor (VICR public), emerging private IVR (Vertical Semi, Skycore). Claros differentiates by spanning IVR (silicon) + Power Gateway (DC distribution) — full-stack approach to data-center efficiency. Red Cell + General Catalyst lead at $30M is unusually large for Seed naming; comparable to Mueon ($15.5M Intel-led) in form-factor ambition. Pre-commercial.
rounds.company_description: Los Angeles startup commercializing integrated voltage regulator (IVR) ICs and a DC-native Power Gateway for AI datacenters — claims 30% power-loss reduction vs. typical IVRs. Three IVR designs already fabbed (Samsung partnership), fourth in development. Founded 2024 by ex-Red Cell Partners alumni.

rounds.co_investors: Wilson Hill Ventures, Freeflow Ventures, Hamamatsu Ventures, Qubits Ventures, Santec, Caltech Seed Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: $6.8M seed+ for nonlinear photonics — comp set: NcodiN ($16M seed, also nonlinear-photonic interposer); Lightium, Akhetonics, Enlightra (all photonic-compute adjacents). PINC's distinct positioning is nonlinear (vs. linear) photonics — frequency conversion, parametric amplification — that unlocks quantum + industrial sensing applications closed to standard silicon photonics. Quantonation lead aligns with quantum-thesis discipline; Hamamatsu + Santec corporate participation signals real off-take pipeline.
rounds.company_description: Caltech spin-out (Pasadena, CA) developing integrated nonlinear photonic devices and circuits for quantum information processing, optical communications, biomedical sensing, and industrial photonics. Founded 2023. Seed+ round closes a multi-tranche $6.8M raise.

rounds.co_investors: Quantonation
rounds.robotnik_take: $3M seed for quantum metrology — comp set: KLAC ($90B+ mcap), Onto Innovation, none with NV-center-based imaging at semiconductor scale. EuQlid is the first commercial quantum-diamond microscope startup to apply NV magnetometry to inline semiconductor inspection — adjacent to the SEM/X-ray inspection workflow rather than replacing it. $1.5M early revenue at announce is rare for a $3M seed; indicates traction with research labs. Pre-commercial for inline fab adoption.
rounds.company_description: College Park, MD startup commercializing Qu-MRI — a quantum diamond-microscope platform using synthetic-diamond nitrogen-vacancy centers for non-destructive 3D imaging of buried currents in semiconductor devices and battery cells. One-micron resolution, AI-driven magnetic-field analysis. Founded by Harvard/Yale/UMD physicists.

rounds.co_investors: HF0 Residency, Techstars, Arka Venture Labs, Together Fund, Higher Life Ventures, Nivesha Ventures, Prana Tech Ventures, KDX Management, Bria, Lex Reddy
rounds.robotnik_take: Pre-seed at $1.7M with an unusually long syndicate (Founders Inc. + HF0 + Techstars + India deeptech angels) signals VC consensus that reentry-capsule + standardized bus = the cleanest seed wedge in the orbital-logistics race. Capsule drop test in <6 months is faster than Varda's pre-Series A cadence. Comps: Varda (private $500M+ post-C), Inversion, Reditus. Real catalyst is whether the Rex/Cosmotron stack converts the disclosed pharma + hypersonic LOIs into orbital flight heritage by 2026.
rounds.company_description: US-based space-infrastructure startup providing turnkey orbital mission services. Developing the Cosmotron satellite bus and the Rex reentry capsule for microgravity research, in-space manufacturing, and hypersonic-defense testing. Founded 2024 by Rifath Shaarook (of KalamSat fame), Clinton D Antony, Keerthan Chand Aluvala, and Saqib Hussain.

rounds.co_investors: Y Combinator
rounds.robotnik_take: Initialized leading at $6.3M makes Spaceium the highest-profile refueling-services seed since Orbit Fab, with the YC backing differentiating it from Indian-incumbent OrbitAID and Polish Liftero on time-to-demo. Refueling is the single biggest unlock for the orbital-logistics layer once Orbit Fab's RAFTI standard becomes prevalent. Comp set is thin (no public comps); private: Orbit Fab, Astroscale (TSE listed), OrbitAID. Catalyst is binary: a successful demo wins the entire serviceable-satellite market.
rounds.company_description: Y Combinator-backed in-orbit refueling startup developing proprietary fuel tanks for long-term cryo propellant storage and robotic arms for space-based refueling. Targets a "network of gas stations" in orbit by decade's end.

rounds.co_investors: Everywhere Ventures, Portland Seed Fund, Thermo, Hunter Communications
rounds.robotnik_take: $4M seed plus a strategic ISP customer (Hunter Communications) on the cap table is rare for a sub-Series-A satcom company. McLain's Starlink lineage matters because the small-GEO thesis — cheaper, faster, fiber-class economics from one slot — only works if a SpaceX-grade engineer architects the bus. Public comps: VSAT, IRDM, ASTS (small-GEO disrupting LEO assumption). Real catalyst is converting the KT SAT order book into delivered units before incumbent GEO operators (Eutelsat, Hughes) respond with their own NGSO programs.
rounds.company_description: Portland, OR-based small-GEO satellite communications startup developing sub-1,000kg geostationary satellites for cost-efficient broadband connectivity. Founded by Chris McLain, ex-SpaceX Starlink principal engineer. Holds $1.8M AFWERX STTR contract; partnered with Optisys on 3D-printed RF components; secured first commercial order from KT SAT in September 2025.

rounds.co_investors: Entrada Ventures, Blue Collective
rounds.robotnik_take: MetaVC lead (the dedicated metamaterials VC) anchors Kapta as the metasurface-radar pure-play to Echodyne's predecessor playbook. Spaceborne radar at LEO is structurally adjacent to ICEYE/Capella SAR but with electronically-steered ground-target-tracking — the GMTI-from-orbit play DoD has pursued for two decades. Public comp set is thin; closest: BlackSky (BKSY) RF, Capella, Iceye (private). Defense customer concentration is the catalyst — and the risk.
rounds.company_description: Seattle-based spaceborne radar startup developing electronically-steered metasurface antenna arrays for LEO satellites. Targets persistent geospatial imagery for Earth observation and ground target tracking for defense — competing structurally with AESA-based incumbents. Founded by Milton Perque (ex-Echodyne) and Adam Bily (ex-Apple, ex-Astranis).

rounds.co_investors: Founders Fund, Balerion Space Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Outsized Ventures, 7percent Ventures, Entrepreneur First
rounds.robotnik_take: $10.5M seed with Redalpine leading and Founders Fund following-on (after leading the pre-seed) is the largest UK satellite-propulsion seed on record. Solid-metal propellant is the structural bet — if Rogue's June flight closes on a working spec impulse, Magdrive becomes a sole-source for the post-Hall-thruster era. Comp set: Phase Four, ISPTech, Bellatrix Aerospace (private); public comp set is essentially zero. Catalyst is the orbital demo; the risk is plasma physics not scaling at the claimed thrust level.
rounds.company_description: UK-based satellite propulsion startup developing high-power electric plasma thrusters using solid metal as propellant — potentially refuelable from recycled "space junk." Combines Hall-Effect specific impulse with order-of-magnitude better thrust per kg. Founded 2019 in Oxfordshire by Mark Stokes (CEO) and Dr Thomas Clayson (CTO). First in-orbit test of Magdrive Rogue scheduled June 2025 with D-Orbit.

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: $3.1M AUD-equivalent seed makes Esper the Australian counterpart to Pixxel and Kuva Space in the SWIR-hyperspectral-for-mining thesis. The mineral-exploration positioning aligns Esper directly with KoBold Metals' AI-exploration thesis but from the orbital sensor side — a complementary picks-and-shovels play. Public comp set: Planet Labs (PL) hyperspectral roadmap, BlackSky (BKSY). Catalyst is the OTR-2 launch (Aug 2025 on Dhruva Space platform) producing commercially-priced SWIR data the mining majors actually buy.
rounds.company_description: Australian hyperspectral imaging satellite startup building a four-satellite "Four Leaf Clover" constellation in shortwave-infrared for mining-deposit detection. Targets cost <$2 per km² versus the mineral-exploration incumbents. CEO Shoaib Iqbal; expansion office in Darwin.

rounds.co_investors: Sovereign's Capital, Flex Capital, FN Fund, Gokul Rajaram
rounds.robotnik_take: Scout Ventures + Seraphim Space co-leading puts PiLogic into the "AI-for-orbital-edge" lane that Sophia Space, Edgx, and Diffraqtion all compete in — but PiLogic's mathematical-precision angle differentiates against the GPU-heavy compute thesis. NASA-validated power-systems diagnostics is the wedge into US space defense customers. Public comp set: NVDA edge-compute roadmap, AMD; private: Sophia Space, Edgx. Catalyst is converting the early defense LOIs into a sole-source contract for orbital AI before Lockheed/Raytheon build it in-house.
rounds.company_description: California-based startup developing "exact AI" — mathematically precise model architecture optimized for onboard satellite deployment, surpassing generative AI in speed, accuracy, and compute efficiency. Validated NASA Electrical Power Systems Diagnostics Model and a Radar Model for object tracking.

rounds.co_investors: Wa'ed Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, KAUST Innovation Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Saudi state-aligned syndicate (TONOMUS/NEOM + Wa'ed/Aramco + KAUST) leading reads less like a venture bet than national-champion seeding for KSA's sovereign-SAR capability. $2.6M is small relative to the global SAR cohort (ICEYE €600M raised, Capella, Umbra) but the geopolitical anchor makes it the MENA SAR consolidator candidate. Public SAR comp set: BKSY (RF), ICEYE (private), Capella (private). Catalyst is whether SARsatX builds the satellites in-country or buys from existing SAR vendors — the former unlocks the sovereign-asset positioning.
rounds.company_description: Saudi Arabian SAR satellite startup spun out of KAUST's TAQADAM accelerator. Building small-SAR satellites for Earth observation with claimed 4-hour data delivery — targeting deforestation, oil-leak detection, disaster response, urban development, and border security across MENA, Africa, Southeast Asia.

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: Pre-seed precedes the Feb-26 $10M seed already in the dataset; the founding ex-JPL pedigree is the unlock — Alkalai led JPL's pre-cosmonaut-era exploration architecture. Orbital data centers is one of the most-hyped 2026 theses (Starcloud, Lonestar, SpaceComputer) but Sophia's passive-cooling angle differentiates from GPU-heavy Starcloud. Public comps: NVDA edge thesis, SuperMicro orbital ambitions; private: Starcloud, SpaceComputer. Catalyst is the first TILE in orbit and whether passive cooling actually delivers the claimed efficiency at >10kW thermal loads.
rounds.company_description: Pasadena-based orbital-compute startup founded by retired JPL Fellow Dr. Leon Alkalai in 2023. Developing modular TILE™ architecture — solid-state, self-sustaining compute modules with passive space-cooling and integrated solar power for orbital data centers. Plans a constellation by the 2030s.

rounds.co_investors: Speciale Invest, Shastra VC, Antler India, DeVC, MGF Kavachh, Anicut Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Kacholia leading (a public-equity ace, not a typical seed-stage VC) signals India's domestic capital believes ISAM is the next exit window after Pixxel/Skyroot. $5.6M for India's first vertically-integrated ISAM platform positions InspeCity as Astroscale's emerging-market analog. Public comp set: ASTR (Tokyo) Astroscale; private: ClearSpace, OrbitAID. Catalyst: hitting space-qualification milestones within the disclosed 12-month window; risk is whether MoU with Japan's Orbital Lasers becomes binding offtake.
rounds.company_description: Mumbai/Thane-based satellite life-extension and ISAM startup. Building a vertically-integrated platform combining propulsion, robotics, and RPOD capabilities for satellite servicing, refueling, deorbit, and mission-life extension. Founded 2022 by IIT Bombay alumni.

rounds.co_investors: Dynamo Ventures, Channel 39
rounds.robotnik_take: Pre-seed at $4M makes Lux Aeterna the most-funded reusable-satellite-bus seed since Outpost; the Q1-2027 demo is one of the cleanest binary catalysts in the orbital-logistics class. Reusable buses are the structural inverse to disposable-smallsat orthodoxy — if Delphi survives reentry, the customer thesis flips from "buy a new sat every mission" to "lease and refly." Comps thin: Outpost (private), Inversion (private), Reditus (private); public: RKLB (Photon). Catalyst is binary; reusability either works or it doesn't.
rounds.company_description: Denver, CO-based startup developing fully-reusable satellite buses that survive atmospheric reentry and re-fly with new payloads. Flagship Delphi spacecraft (~200kg, ~25% payload mass fraction) targeting Q1 2027 demonstration mission. Vision: 15-flight reusability per vehicle.

rounds.co_investors: 468 Capital, Unshackled Ventures, Rebel Fund, Maiora Ventures, Laura Crabtree, Benjamin Bryant, Kanav Kariya
rounds.robotnik_take: Oversubscribed seed at $45M post-money is the highest valuation of any space pre-Series-A in this window — a YC-effect amplifier on what is essentially a thin-customer-validated cold-start play. The $140M LOI book is the real story; if even 10% converts to bookings by 2027, Apolink eats Iridium's (IRDM) LEO relay segment. Public comps: IRDM (TDRSS analog), ASTS (LEO comms). Risk: 19-year-old founder navigating Iridium- and Hughes-incumbent regulatory friction.
rounds.company_description: Palo Alto-based satellite-connectivity startup (formerly Bifrost Orbital) building a 32-satellite LEO relay constellation for real-time 24/7 connectivity. FCC-licensed; each orbital ring designed for 256 users at 9.6kbps. Founded by 19-year-old Onkar Singh Batra. $140M+ in LOIs from Astro Digital, Hubble Network, Star Catcher.

rounds.co_investors: Y Combinator, Nova Threshold, Undeterred Capital, Night Capital, Olive Capital, Valkyrie Ventures, Karman Ventures, Palm Drive Capital, Garage Capital, TRAC, Aurelia Foundry, Hawktail, MGV.VC, Pioneer Fund, Liquid 2 Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Long-tail syndicate ($5.9M across 15+ funds, no clean lead) reads as a Y Combinator party round on an unusually broad cap table — risky for governance but signals consensus on space-comms software being the under-built layer. Crew Dragon comms architect on the founding team is the unlock. Public comp set: Viasat (VSAT), Iridium (IRDM); private: Atlas Space, AWS Ground Station. Catalyst is whether the open-source Spacelink library captures developer mindshare the way GitHub Copilot did for code — a 2-3 year horizon.
rounds.company_description: California-based satellite-communications-platform startup (fka Heliosphere Network) building an end-to-end design + ops platform for spacecraft comms — including the open-source Spacelink library for link-budget modeling, an online design tool, and a planned ground-station network for lunar missions. Founded by Jacob Portukalian (architected SpaceX Crew Dragon comms) and Arlen Abraham (Astra launch systems).

rounds.lead_investors: UK Innovation & Science Seed Fund, Foresight Group, Blackfinch Ventures
rounds.co_investors: Seraphim Space
rounds.robotnik_take: Tri-led seed at $7.3M (£5.4M) with the UK government's seed fund anchoring is the cleanest UK-MoD signal yet — Spaceflux subsequently won all three NSpOC SDA contracts. SDA is the under-built domain where geopolitical urgency (Russia-Ukraine, Taiwan) creates 5-year demand visibility. Public comp set: LeoLabs (private), Slingshot (private), HawkEye 360 (private $150M Series E in dataset). Catalyst is whether the UKSA/MoD contracts grow from data feeds into the operational layer of UK Space Command.
rounds.company_description: London-based space-domain-awareness startup developing a proprietary global telescope network with AI-driven analytics. Combines visible + SWIR optical sensors for 24/7 satellite/debris tracking across all orbits. Founded 2022; holds three multi-year UK Government SST contracts under NSpOC framework.

rounds.co_investors: id4 Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: Pre-seed at €1.5M with €81M in LOIs is the strongest LOI-to-funding ratio in this entire sweep. Orbital Paradigm is the European complement to US-based Varda/Catalyx/Reditus — same reentry-services thesis, different sovereign exposure (European customers want EU-controlled return-cargo for ITAR-sensitive payloads). Comp set: Varda (private), Reditus (private), Catalyx (private); thin public comps. Catalyst is the KID mission separating + transmitting + surviving; the second mission is already 80% pre-sold.
rounds.company_description: Madrid-based reusable orbital reentry capsule startup. Building Kestrel reentry vehicles with ceramic thermal shields and proprietary guidance software for low-G recovery on European soil. Test capsule KID flies maiden mission late 2025; €81M LOI pipeline across 18 clients; founded 2023 by ex-ESA engineer Francesco Cacciatore.

rounds.co_investors: Flanders Future Tech Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: Belgian regional-fund-led seed at €2.3M with an NVIDIA-anchored hardware stack puts EDGX in the same orbital-AI lane as Sophia Space/PiLogic but with a different defensibility model — the Sterna board ships hardware, not just software. The pre-Series-A commercial booking (€1.1M offtake before institutional series A) is the strongest revenue signal in this cohort. Public comp set: NVDA datacenter, AMD MI300; private: Sophia Space, PiLogic. Catalyst: the Feb-26 SpaceX flight proving radiation-tolerance specs.
rounds.company_description: Ghent-based Belgian spacetech building EDGX Sterna — an NVIDIA-powered edge-AI computer for satellites with a SpaceFeather software stack including radiation-fault recovery and post-launch app deployment. Multi-unit deal with undisclosed operator (€1.1M) plus February 2026 SpaceX Falcon 9 in-orbit demo. Founded 2023.

rounds.co_investors: Feel Ventures, General Electric Company, Sie Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $1.5M seed plus GE on the cap table is unusual — GE doesn't typically participate at pre-Series-A in space, suggesting Barnacle™ is structurally relevant to GE Aerospace's materials qualification workflow. Female Founders Fund leading is the rare gender-anchored space-tech check (founder Bianca Cefalo). Comp set is thin: Space DOTS is more adjacent to Aerospace Corp's contract-research than to a public comp. Catalyst is whether GE converts to a binding offtake.
rounds.company_description: London-based space-tech-instrumentation startup detecting in-orbit material anomalies via Barnacle™ embedded test platform. Launched 2022 to provide spaceflight-data services for space-tech manufacturers and operators. Founded by Bianca Cefalo.

rounds.co_investors: ATX Venture Partners, Mana Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $3M pre-seed for in-orbit assembly is the largest disclosed seed in the space-station-successor cohort post-Axiom/Vast. MIT-derived TESSERAE technology + Joe Landon (ex-Lockheed Martin Ventures, ex-Voyager Space) is the credibility stack. The ISS demo in early 2026 is the binary catalyst. Comp set thin: Axiom (private, $350M debt Feb-26), Vast (Series A in dataset $500M), Starlab; public: nil. Risk is whether self-assembly works at the claimed precision with electromagnetic formation flight.
rounds.company_description: Golden, CO-based modular in-orbit assembly startup developing TESSERAE technology — flat-packed, dinner-plate-sized tiles that self-assemble in orbit using electromagnetic formation flight. Spinout from MIT (Dr. Ariel Ekblaw) via the Aurelia Institute. Test flight on ISS in early 2026 with 32 tiles. Co-founders: Ekblaw, Phil Frank, Joe Landon (ex-Lockheed Martin Ventures).

rounds.co_investors: JOIN Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: NATO Innovation Fund's first satellite investment, at €8M seed, is a strong sovereign-VLEO signal — VLEO is the structural answer to Starlink for European defense customers wanting sub-LEO resolution without Russian/Chinese exposure. Comp set: Univity (Series A in dataset $32M, similar VLEO 5G), Earth-i, satellogic (SATL); public comp set is essentially zero for VLEO. Catalyst is the ABEP demo flight — if it works, Kreios becomes Europe's structural answer to Starshield.
rounds.company_description: Spanish VLEO-satellite startup developing ABEP (air-breathing electric propulsion) engines that enable satellites to operate between 150-400km altitude — three-times-sharper imagery and broadband direct-to-device connectivity. Two test satellites planned including world's first in-orbit ABEP demonstration.

rounds.co_investors: Galaxia, Obloo Ventures, Eureka Fund I, Puglia Co-Investment Fund
rounds.robotnik_take: Primo Capital (Italy's dedicated space-economy VC) lead at €2M for a foldable-PV startup with dual space + terrestrial product lines is one of the cleanest sole-source Italian-space seeds. Solar arrays are the most under-discussed bottleneck in the smallsat cost curve — every kg saved on PV unlocks more payload. Comp set thin: SolAero (acquired by Rocket Lab RKLB), Spectrolab (BA-owned); private: Solestial (Series A in dataset $17M). Catalyst is satellite-integrator design wins; risk is competing against vertically-integrated PV from Rocket Lab.
rounds.company_description: Bari-based Italian SpaceTech developing Solar-Z — ultralight foldable solar panels for satellites, plus parallel Solar-Y product line for terrestrial deployable PV. Targets TRL 9 via in-orbit LEO testing and satellite-integrator offtake agreements. Founded 2021.

rounds.co_investors: Uday Chatterjee, Romesh Sobti, Suraj Nalin
rounds.robotnik_take: $1.2M pre-seed with three-way VC lead (LVX/1Crowd/Riceberg) puts Akashalabdhi into India's emerging space-habitat thesis alongside Cosmoserve and Aule Space. Expandable habitats are structurally aligned with Sierra Space LIFE module + Bigelow legacy but at sub-1% the capital intensity. Comp set: Sierra Space (private $8B post-money), Vast (Series A $500M, Mar-26), Axiom (private). Catalyst is the MVP launch; risk is whether Indian launch capacity (PSLV/SSLV) can host the expanded form factor.
rounds.company_description: Indian space-habitat startup developing ANTARIKSHAB — expandable orbital structures for microgravity research, defense, and habitation use cases. Also developing inflatable solar arrays and analogue environment studies. Incubated at FSID (IISc) and TIDES (IIT Roorkee); KickSky Accelerator alumnus. Founded by Siddharth Jena.

rounds.co_investors: BYT Capital, DeVC
rounds.robotnik_take: Speciale Invest lead at INR 14Cr (~$1.6M) makes VyomIC India's most-credible LEO-PNT seed. Sovereign-PNT is the long-tail GPS-replacement market China (BeiDou), Russia (GLONASS), and Europe (Galileo) already monetize at $B-scale — India has been the conspicuous absence. Comp set: Xona Space Systems (Series C in dataset $170M), TrustPoint, Astranis (not PNT but private $1.2B raised). Catalyst is the spaceborne demo mission; risk is sovereign-PNT requiring 30+ satellites before usable signal coverage.
rounds.company_description: Chennai-based deeptech startup building India's first private LEO-PNT constellation — onboard atomic clocks, encrypted signal layers, AI-driven orbit determination for indoor/urban/contested-environment navigation as a GPS-alternative. Founded by IIT Madras alumni Lokesh Kabdal, Vibhor Jain, Anurag Patil.

rounds.co_investors: AUM Ventures, Shakti VC, Ram Shriram
rounds.robotnik_take: $3.17M pre-seed is among the largest concept-stage Indian space rounds disclosed. Ex-Gaganyaan deputy-project-director + Ram Shriram (early Google + Sequoia veteran) on the cap table is rarified validation for a pre-revenue founder team. Active-debris-removal is the under-funded twin to ISAM — Astroscale's market positioning but for distributed removal at scale. Comp set: ASTR (Astroscale, Tokyo public), ClearSpace (private CHF40M raised), Privateer (private). Catalyst is the first robotic-spacecraft demo and whether IN-SPACe certification accelerates.
rounds.company_description: Indian space-tech startup developing autonomous robotic spacecraft for orbital-debris mitigation. Founded by Dr. Chiranjeevi Phanindra (former ISRO scientist + Deputy Project Director of India's Gaganyaan human-spaceflight mission). Heavily oversubscribed pre-seed; LOIs include Skyroot co-founder Pawan Kumar Chandana as strategic backer.

rounds.co_investors: Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Mission
rounds.robotnik_take: $1.5M pre-seed with a state-government co-investor (TANSIM) positions OrbitAID as Tamil Nadu's flagship space play — comparable to Karnataka's backing of Skyroot/Pixxel. Refueling-services market is structurally aligned with Spaceium (YC), Orbit Fab, and Liftero (Poland) — global TAM is ~$10B by 2030 per Astroscale estimates. SIDRP standard adoption is the leverage point. Comp set thin: ORF, Orbit Fab (private), Spaceium (YC seed in this list); public: nil. Catalyst is the miniature tanker demo and whether SIDRP becomes a de facto industry standard.
rounds.company_description: Chennai-based on-orbit-refueling startup developing the Standard Interface Docking and Refueling Port (SIDRP). Plans a miniature tanker satellite demo within 4 months of close, full tanker by 2027, and a deployed fuel-station network by 2030. Founded 2021 by Sakthikumar R, Nikhil Balasubramanian, Mano Balaji K.

rounds.co_investors: Vertis (Vertis Venture 6 Digital South), Galaxia, Obloo Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: €4M extension led by CDP (Italy's sovereign-wealth-adjacent venture arm) with NextGenerationEU backing — explicitly classified as Series A by company but functionally a Seed-extension by ticket size. EO-as-infrastructure-monitoring is the post-Planet thesis: not selling pixels but selling integrity assessments for capital-asset operators. Comp set: Planet Labs (PL), BlackSky (BKSY), Satellogic (SATL); private: ICEYE, Capella. Catalyst is winning national-grid or rail infrastructure offtake — a deep-customer-validation play, not technology risk.
rounds.company_description: Rome-based AI-driven Earth-intelligence platform. Integrates satellite data, ground sensors, and climate models to analyze infrastructure conditions (bridges, dams, water/energy/transport networks) and identify anomalies. Founded 2019; ESA BIC Lazio alumnus; spun out of ESA Earth-Observation HQ in Frascati.

rounds.co_investors: Undisclosed
rounds.robotnik_take: Seed (third-party allotment + loans, exact composition undisclosed) makes BULL the only Japanese post-mission-disposal pure-play with a J-Startup designation. PMD-as-a-service is the structural offshoot of the active-debris-removal market — instead of removing existing debris, prevent future debris at the satellite-design stage. Comp set: Astroscale (ASTR Tokyo public), Privateer (private), ClearSpace (private). Catalyst is whether JAXA's debris-mitigation regulation mandates PMD-style devices on Japanese satellites — a regulatory tailwind catalyst, not a technology one.
rounds.company_description: Japanese space-sustainability startup spun out of ALE Co.'s 2022 debris-management-division divestiture. Develops Post-Mission Disposal — a thin-film membrane coating that creates drag, slowing satellites and accelerating natural deorbit. J-Startup public-private-partnership 5th-cohort selection. Founded by Yasuhito Uto.

rounds.co_investors: Aera VC
rounds.robotnik_take: $7.1M is the largest reusable-reentry-vehicle seed disclosed since Outpost ($7.1M, 2022) and Inversion ($10.2M, 2022). YC + Antler co-anchoring with a party-style cap table reflects YC's deepening space-thesis allocation (Apolink, Catalyx, Sophia all YC). Microgravity-as-a-Service competes structurally with Varda's pharma path but at 1/20th the burn — Reditus' 40kg payload is small enough to fly on rideshares. Comp set: Varda (private), Catalyx (in this list), Lux Aeterna (in this list), Orbital Paradigm (in this list). Catalyst: summer-2026 demo launch.
rounds.company_description: Atlanta-based reusable-spacecraft startup developing ENOS — a free-flying, reusable reentry vehicle with 40kg payload return capability. "Microgravity-as-a-Service" model targeting pharma, biotech, and semiconductor-substrate customers. Founded October 2024 by Stef Crum and Will Sherman, both Georgia Tech engineering grads. Y Combinator W25 cohort.

rounds.co_investors: Generational Partners, Forward Deployed VC, Bloomberg Beta, Wave Function Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $8M seed for a year-old space-defense startup with a SpaceX+Hermeus-pedigreed CEO is the cleanest defense-space-pure-play seed since True Anomaly's 2022 raise. Pentagon's mounting urgency on orbital-defense capability (post-2024 Russian anti-sat doctrine) creates a 5-year demand catalyst. Comp set: True Anomaly (Series D in dataset $650M Apr-26 — i.e., 4yrs from seed-to-$2.2B-valuation), Apex (Series D), Anduril (private $30B). Catalyst is converting "intent to procure" into DoD prime-contract awards under SDA Tranche 3+ or Space Force NSSL Lane 1 adjacent.
rounds.company_description: California-based defense-space startup building maneuverable, resilient spacecraft for satellite-defense, defensive RPO, and assured mission execution. Founded 2025 in Torrance, CA. CEO Mike Smayda (5yrs SpaceX senior aerodynamics; Hermeus co-founder).

rounds.co_investors: Harpoon Ventures, Brave Capital, Point Nine, 2100 Ventures, Entropy Industrial Capital
rounds.robotnik_take: Stanford spinoff + NASA contract + Haystack lead at $5.3M oversubscribed positions EraDrive as the cooperative-autonomy edge-case to Slingshot/LeoLabs (which sense + warn, don't act) — EraDrive sells the responsive layer. As LEO traffic doubles by 2030 (Starlink + Kuiper + Guowang + Thousand Sails), autonomous evasion becomes table-stakes for any operator with >100 satellites. Comp set: Slingshot (private), LeoLabs (private), Privateer (private); public: nil yet. Catalyst is whether SDA-Tranche-3+ requires onboard autonomy.
rounds.company_description: California-based Stanford spinoff developing software-hardware autonomy modules for satellites — enabling cooperative maneuvering using observational data to reduce collision risk. CEO Sumant Sharma; won $1M NASA contract. Plans to double headcount to 15.

rounds.co_investors: milemark capital, Aether VC, ADIN, Offline Ventures
rounds.robotnik_take: $4.2M pre-seed (dilutive + DARPA SBIR Phase 2 non-dilutive) for an MIT+UMD quantum-imaging spinout is the rare quantum-sensing-for-space play with a Space Force SDA-TAP-Lab partnership. The 20x-resolution claim is the wedge — if validated at altitude, Diffraqtion eats Maxar's sub-meter market. Public comp set: MAXR.PR (Maxar private now), Planet (PL), BlackSky (BKSY). Private comp: Albedo. Risk is whether quantum imaging scales beyond benchtop physics; catalyst is the 2026 on-sky demo at UC Lick Observatory.
rounds.company_description: Somerville, MA-based MIT/UMD spinout developing quantum-camera technology for satellite and telescope constellations. Claims up to 20x higher resolution + 1,000x faster processing vs conventional sensors. Founders: Johannes Galatsanos (CEO), Christine Wang (CTO), Prof. Saikat Guha (Chief Science Advisor). Galileo-1 launch 2028; second satellite 2029.

rounds.co_investors: Eash Sundaram, Arvind Lakshmikumar
